def persistence_of(branch_name, model):
    pers=model.get("persistence",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(pers):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
            if "/" in branch_name:
                last=branch_name.split("/")[-1]
                if re.search(pat, last):
                    return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(pers)

def order_of(branch_name, model):
    order=model.get("order",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(order):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(order)

def assign_branches(commits, refs, model):
    # Build branches from refs
    branches=[]
    for r in refs:
        branches.append({"name":r["name"],"hash":r["hash"],"is_tag":r["is_tag"],"is_remote":r["is_remote"],"tag_name":r.get("tag_name"),"is_unknown":False})
    # persistence sort
    pers_list=[]
    for idx,br in enumerate(branches):
        pers_list.append((persistence_of(br["name"], model), idx))
    pers_list.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    assigned={}
    ranges={}
    for _,b_idx in pers_list:
        br=branches[b_idx]
        if br["hash"] not in hm:
            continue
        cur=hm[br["hash"]]
        first=True
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            h=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if h in assigned:
                if not first:
                    break
                else:
                    if assigned[h]!=b_idx:
                        start=None
                        break
            else:
                assigned[h]=b_idx
                commits[cur]["branch"]=br["name"]
                if first:
                    start=cur
                    end=cur
                    first=False
                else:
                    if cur<start: start=cur
                    if cur>end: end=cur
            # first parent
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        if start is not None:
            ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    # unknown branches for unassigned
    unassigned=[c["hash"] for c in commits if c["hash"] not in assigned]
    unassigned_sorted=sorted(unassigned, key=lambda h: hm[h])
    for h in unassigned_sorted:
        if h in assigned:
            continue
        branches.append({"name":"unknown","hash":h,"is_tag":False,"is_remote":False,"is_unknown":True})
        b_idx=len(branches)-1
        cur=hm[h]
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            ch=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if ch in assigned:
                break
            assigned[ch]=b_idx
            commits[cur]["branch"]="unknown"
            if cur<start: start=cur
            if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    # Extend ranges for merges: if merge commit has second parent belonging to other branch, extend that other branch's start to include merge
    for i,c in enumerate(commits):
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for parent_hash in c["parents"][1:]:
                if parent_hash in assigned:
                    pb_idx=assigned[parent_hash]
                    if pb_idx in ranges:
                        s,e=ranges[pb_idx]
                        if i < s:
                            ranges[pb_idx]=(i,e)
                        # also ensure e covers parent
                        # parent idx
                        if parent_hash in hm:
                            p_idx=hm[parent_hash]
                            if p_idx > e:
                                ranges[pb_idx]=(ranges[pb_idx][0], p_idx)
    return branches, assigned, ranges

def build_decoration(commit, head_info):
    branch_refs=[]
    tag_refs=[]
    for r in commit["refs"]:
        if r.get("is_tag"):
            tag_refs.append(r.get("tag_name") or r["short"])
        else:
            branch_refs.append(r)
    branch_names=[]
    for r in branch_refs:
        branch_names.append(r["name"])
    # HEAD handling
    is_head = (commit["hash"] == head_info.get("head_hash"))
    head_branch = head_info.get("head_branch")
    if is_head:
        if head_branch:
            if head_branch in branch_names:
                new=[]
                for b in branch_names:
                    if b==head_branch:
                        new.append(f"HEAD -> {b}")
                    else:
                        new.append(b)
                branch_names=new
            else:
                branch_names=[f"HEAD -> {head_branch}"]+branch_names
        else:
            branch_names=["HEAD"]+branch_names
    dec=""
    if branch_names:
        dec+=" ("+", ".join(branch_names)+")"
    if tag_refs:
        dec+=" ["+", ".join(tag_refs)+"]"
    return dec

def format_date(unix_str):
    try:
        ts=int(unix_str)
    except:
        return unix_str
    import datetime
    dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
    day=dt.day
    day_str=f"{day:2d}"
    prefix=dt.strftime("%a %b")
    time_part=dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    year=dt.strftime("%Y")
    return f"{prefix}{day_str} {time_part} {year} +0000"

def format_commit(commit, fmt_str, head_info):
    # Build expansions
    dec=build_decoration(commit, head_info)
    ex={
        "%H": commit["hash"],
        "%h": commit["hash"][:7],
        "%P": " ".join(commit["parents"]),
        "%p": " ".join([p[:7] for p in commit["parents"]]),
        "%d": dec,
        "%s": commit["s"],
        "%b": commit["b"],
        "%B": commit["B"],
        "%an": commit["an"],
        "%ae": commit["ae"],
        "%ad": format_date(commit["at"]),
        "%as": commit["as"],
        "%cn": commit["cn"],
        "%ce": commit["ce"],
        "%cd": format_date(commit["ct"]),
        "%cs": commit["cs"],
        "%n": "\n",
    }
    res=[]
    j=0
    while j < len(fmt_str):
        if fmt_str[j]=='%':
            # modifier?
            if j+1 < len(fmt_str) and fmt_str[j+1] in ('+','-',' '):
                mod=fmt_str[j+1]
                # placeholder
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+3 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+2:j+4]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+2]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        found="%%"
                        ph_len=1
                if found:
                    exp=ex.get(found, found)
                    if mod=='+':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append("\n")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod==' ':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append(" ")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod=='-':
                        if exp=="":
                            combined="".join(res)
                            combined=combined.rstrip("\n")
                            res=[combined]
                        else:
                            res.append(exp)
                    j+=2+ph_len
                    continue
                else:
                    # unknown
                    if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                        res.append(fmt_str[j:j+3])
                        j+=3
                        continue
            else:
                # no mod
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+1:j+3]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+1 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+1]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        res.append("%%")
                        j+=2
                        continue
                    else:
                        res.append("%"+one)
                        j+=2
                        continue
                if found:
                    res.append(ex.get(found, found))
                    j+=1+ph_len
                    continue
        res.append(fmt_str[j])
        j+=1
    return "".join(res)

def term_color_for_branch(branch_name, model, counter_map):
    # counter_map: pattern index -> count
    term_matches=model.get("term_matches",[])
    term_unknown=model.get("term_unknown",[])
    for idx,(pat,cols) in enumerate(term_matches):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                cnt=counter_map.get(idx,0)
                counter_map[idx]=cnt+1
                if cols:
                    return cols[cnt % len(cols)]
        except:
            continue
    # unknown
    cnt=counter_map.get("unknown",0)
    counter_map["unknown"]=cnt+1
    if term_unknown:
        return term_unknown[cnt % len(term_unknown)]
    return "white"

def ansi_for_color(name):
    mapping={
        "black":0,"red":1,"green":2,"yellow":3,"blue":4,"magenta":5,"cyan":6,"white":7,
        "bright_black":8,"bright_red":9,"bright_green":10,"bright_yellow":11,"bright_blue":12,"bright_magenta":13,"bright_cyan":14,"bright_white":15,
    }
    if name in mapping:
        return f"\x1b[38;5;{mapping[name]}m"
    if name.isdigit():
        try:
            return f"\x1b[38;5;{int(name)}m"
        except:
            pass
    return ""

def svg_color_for_branch(branch_name, model, counter_map):
    matches=model.get("svg_matches",[])
    unknown=model.get("svg_unknown",[])
    for idx,(pat,cols) in enumerate(matches):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                cnt=counter_map.get(idx,0)
                counter_map[idx]=cnt+1
                if cols:
                    return cols[cnt % len(cols)]
        except:
            continue
    cnt=counter_map.get("unknown",0)
    counter_map["unknown"]=cnt+1
    if unknown:
        return unknown[cnt % len(unknown)]
    return "gray"

def persistence_of(branch_name, model):
    pers=model.get("persistence",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(pers):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
            if "/" in branch_name:
                last=branch_name.split("/")[-1]
                if re.search(pat, last):
                    return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(pers)

    order=model.get("order",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(order):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(order)

    if branch_names:

    if tag_refs:
        dec+=" ["+", ".join(tag_refs)+"]"
    return dec

def format_date(unix_str):
    try:
        ts=int(unix_str)
    except:
        return unix_str
    import datetime
    dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
    day=dt.day
    day_str=f"{day:2d}"
    prefix=dt.strftime("%a %b")
    time_part=dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    year=dt.strftime("%Y")
    return f"{prefix}{day_str} {time_part} {year} +0000"

def format_commit(commit, fmt_str, head_info):
    dec=build_decoration(commit, head_info)
    ex={
        "%H": commit["hash"],
        "%h": commit["hash"][:7],
        "%P": " ".join(commit["parents"]),
        "%p": " ".join([p[:7] for p in commit["parents"]]),
        "%d": dec,
        "%s": commit["s"],
        "%b": commit["b"],
        "%B": commit["B"],
        "%an": commit["an"],
        "%ae": commit["ae"],
        "%ad": format_date(commit["at"]),
        "%as": commit["as"],
        "%cn": commit["cn"],
        "%ce": commit["ce"],
        "%cd": format_date(commit["ct"]),
        "%cs": commit["cs"],
        "%n": "\n",
    }
    res=[]
    j=0
    while j < len(fmt_str):
        if fmt_str[j]=='%':
            if j+1 < len(fmt_str) and fmt_str[j+1] in ('+','-',' '):
                mod=fmt_str[j+1]
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+3 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+2:j+4]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+2]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        found="%%"
                        ph_len=1
                if found:
                    exp=ex.get(found, found)
                    if mod=='+':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append("\n")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod==' ':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append(" ")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod=='-':
                        if exp=="":
                            combined="".join(res)
                            combined=combined.rstrip("\n")
                            res=[combined]
                        else:
                            res.append(exp)
                    j+=2+ph_len
                    continue
                else:
                    if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                        res.append(fmt_str[j:j+3])
                        j+=3
                        continue
            else:
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+1:j+3]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+1 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+1]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        res.append("%%")
                        j+=2
                        continue
                    else:
                        res.append("%"+one)
                        j+=2
                        continue
                if found:
                    res.append(ex.get(found, found))
                    j+=1+ph_len
                    continue
        res.append(fmt_str[j])
        j+=1
    return "".join(res)

def ansi_for_color(name):
    mapping={
        "black":0,"red":1,"green":2,"yellow":3,"blue":4,"magenta":5,"cyan":6,"white":7,
        "bright_black":8,"bright_red":9,"bright_green":10,"bright_yellow":11,"bright_blue":12,"bright_magenta":13,"bright_cyan":14,"bright_white":15,
    }
    if name in mapping:
        return f"\x1b[38;5;{mapping[name]}m"
    if name.isdigit():
        try:
            return f"\x1b[38;5;{int(name)}m"
        except:
            pass
    return ""

def render_commits(commits, branches, ranges, col_assign, style, model, fmt_str, head_info, use_color, debug_extra=False):
    # Simplified rendering: one line per commit with graph prefix
    # Determine order groups and column assignment already done, but we need to use col_assign
    # Build branch name to col
    name_to_col={}
    for b_idx,br in enumerate(branches):
        name_to_col[br["name"]]=col_assign.get(b_idx,0)

    # active_at
    def active_at(idx):
        cols=[]
        for b_idx,(s,e) in ranges.items():
            if s <= idx <= e:
                cols.append(col_assign.get(b_idx,0))
        return sorted(set(cols))

    # style chars
    if style=="ascii":
        commit_char="*"
        merge_char="o"
        vertical="|"
        horizontal="-"
    else:
        commit_char="●"
        merge_char="○"
        vertical="│" if style in ("normal","thin","round") else ("┃" if style=="bold" else "║")
        horizontal="─" if style in ("normal","thin","round") else ("━" if style=="bold" else "═")

    lines=[]
    for idx,c in enumerate(commits):
        cur_branch=c.get("branch")
        cur_col=name_to_col.get(cur_branch,0)
        active=active_at(idx)
        max_active = max(active) if active else cur_col
        blocks=[]
        for col in range(max_active+1):
            if col==cur_col:
                ch=merge_char if len(c["parents"])>1 else commit_char
                blocks.append(f" {ch} ")
            else:
                if col in active:
                    blocks.append(f" {vertical} ")
                else:
                    blocks.append("   ")
        # Merge adjustments
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for ph in c["parents"][1:]:
                # find parent commit idx
                p_idx=None
                for j,c2 in enumerate(commits):
                    if c2["hash"]==ph:
                        p_idx=j
                        break
                if p_idx is None:
                    continue
                parent_branch=commits[p_idx].get("branch")
                parent_col=name_to_col.get(parent_branch)
                if parent_col is None:
                    continue
                if parent_col > cur_col:
                    b0=list(blocks[cur_col])
                    if len(b0)>=3:
                        b0[2]='<'
                    blocks[cur_col]="".join(b0)
                    for cc in range(cur_col+1, parent_col):
                        if style=="ascii":
                            blocks[cc]="---"
                        else:
                            blocks[cc]=horizontal*3
                    if style=="ascii":
                        b1=list(blocks[parent_col])
                        b1[0]='.'
                        blocks[parent_col]="".join(b1)
                    else:
                        corner="┐" if style in ("normal","thin") else ("╮" if style=="round" else ("┓" if style=="bold" else "╗"))
                        b1=list(blocks[parent_col])
                        b1[0]=corner
                        blocks[parent_col]="".join(b1)
                elif parent_col < cur_col:
                    b0=list(blocks[cur_col])
                    if len(b0)>=3:
                        b0[0]='>'
                    blocks[cur_col]="".join(b0)
                    for cc in range(parent_col+1, cur_col):
                        if style=="ascii":
                            blocks[cc]="---"
                        else:
                            blocks[cc]=horizontal*3
                    if style=="ascii":
                        b1=list(blocks[parent_col])
                        b1[2]='.'
                        blocks[parent_col]="".join(b1)
                    else:
                        corner="┌" if style in ("normal","thin") else ("╭" if style=="round" else ("┏" if style=="bold" else "╔"))
                        b1=list(blocks[parent_col])
                        b1[2]=corner
                        blocks[parent_col]="".join(b1)

        graph="".join(blocks)
        ft=format_commit(c, fmt_str, head_info)
        # For wrapping, we ignore (treat as none)
        lines.append(f"{graph}{ft}")

        # Connection row for branch ending (simplified ascii only)
        if idx+1 < len(commits):
            next_active=active_at(idx+1)
            ending=[col for col in active if col not in next_active]
            if ending and style=="ascii":
                # For minimal case, produce " |-'  " like
                # Find parent col for ending branch (assume 0)
                # Only handle single ending at rightmost
                if len(ending)==1:
                    ec=ending[0]
                    # Build connection row with vertical for next_active and '-' and "'"
                    conn=[]
                    for col in range(max_active+1):
                        if col in next_active:
                            # if col is parent of ending, show " |" + "-"
                            if col < ec:
                                # check if this col is parent of ending branch: find branch ending at idx whose parent col == col
                                # Simplified: if col==0 and ec==1, then " |-"
                                if col==0 and ec==1:
                                    conn.append(f" {vertical}{horizontal}")
                                else:
                                    conn.append(f" {vertical} ")
                            else:
                                conn.append(f" {vertical} ")
                        elif col==ec:
                            conn.append("'  ")
                        else:
                            conn.append("   ")
                    # For 2 columns case ending col1
                    if max_active==1 and ec==1:
                        conn=[f" {vertical}{horizontal}", "'  "]
                    lines.append("".join(conn))

    return lines

    if p.is_file():

def get_refs(repo, local=False):
    fmt = "%(objectname) %(refname) %(refname:short)"
    cmd = ["for-each-ref", "--format", fmt]
    if local:
        cmd += ["refs/heads","refs/tags"]
    else:
        cmd += ["refs/heads","refs/remotes","refs/tags"]
    out,_,_ = run_git(repo, *cmd)
    refs=[]
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if not line.strip(): continue
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)<3: continue
        obj, refname, short = parts[0], parts[1], parts[2]
        if refname.startswith("refs/heads/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/heads/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":False,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/remotes/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/remotes/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":True,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/tags/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/tags/"):]
            internal=f"tags/{name}"
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":internal,"short":short,"kind":"tag","is_remote":False,"is_tag":True,"tag_name":name})

    out,_,_ = run_git(repo, *cmd)
    commits=[]
    for rec in out.split("\x1f"):
        if not rec.strip(): continue
        rec=rec.lstrip("\n")
        fields=rec.split("\x00")
        if len(fields)<13: continue
        H=fields[0].strip()
        P=fields[1].strip()
        parents=P.split() if P else []
        commits.append({
            "hash":H,"parents":parents,
            "an":fields[2],"ae":fields[3],"at":fields[4],"as":fields[5],
            "cn":fields[6],"ce":fields[7],"ct":fields[8],"cs":fields[9],
            "s":fields[10],"b":fields[11],"B":fields[12],
            "refs":[],"branch":None
        })
    if reverse:
        commits=list(reversed(commits))
    if max_count is not None:
        commits=commits[:max_count]
    return commits

def persistence_of(branch_name, model):
    pers=model.get("persistence",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(pers):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
            if "/" in branch_name:
                last=branch_name.split("/")[-1]
                if re.search(pat, last):
                    return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(pers)

def order_of(branch_name, model):
    order=model.get("order",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(order):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(order)

    branches=[]
    for r in refs:
        branches.append({"name":r["name"],"hash":r["hash"],"is_tag":r["is_tag"],"is_remote":r["is_remote"],"tag_name":r.get("tag_name"),"is_unknown":False})
    pers_list=[]
    for idx,br in enumerate(branches):
        pers_list.append((persistence_of(br["name"], model), idx))
    pers_list.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    assigned={}
    ranges={}
    for _,b_idx in pers_list:
        br=branches[b_idx]
        if br["hash"] not in hm:
            continue
        cur=hm[br["hash"]]
        first=True
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            h=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if h in assigned:
                if not first:
                    break
                else:
                    if assigned[h]!=b_idx:
                        start=None
                        break
            else:
                assigned[h]=b_idx
                commits[cur]["branch"]=br["name"]
                if first:
                    start=cur
                    end=cur
                    first=False
                else:
                    if cur<start: start=cur
                    if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        if start is not None:
            ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    unassigned=[c["hash"] for c in commits if c["hash"] not in assigned]
    unassigned_sorted=sorted(unassigned, key=lambda h: hm[h])
    for h in unassigned_sorted:
        if h in assigned:
            continue
        branches.append({"name":"unknown","hash":h,"is_tag":False,"is_remote":False,"is_unknown":True})
        b_idx=len(branches)-1
        cur=hm[h]
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            ch=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if ch in assigned:
                break
            assigned[ch]=b_idx
            commits[cur]["branch"]="unknown"
            if cur<start: start=cur
            if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    for i,c in enumerate(commits):
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for ph in c["parents"][1:]:
                if ph in assigned:
                    pb_idx=assigned[ph]
                    if pb_idx in ranges:
                        s,e=ranges[pb_idx]
                        if i < s:
                            ranges[pb_idx]=(i,e)
    return branches, assigned, ranges

def build_decoration(commit, head_info):
    branch_refs=[]
    tag_refs=[]
    for r in commit["refs"]:
        if r.get("is_tag"):
            tag_refs.append(r.get("tag_name") or r["short"])
        else:
            branch_refs.append(r)
    branch_names=[r["name"] for r in branch_refs]
    is_head = (commit["hash"] == head_info.get("head_hash"))
    head_branch = head_info.get("head_branch")
    if is_head:
        if head_branch:
            if head_branch in branch_names:
                new=[]
                for b in branch_names:
                    if b==head_branch:
                        new.append(f"HEAD -> {b}")
                    else:
                        new.append(b)
                branch_names=new
            else:
                branch_names=[f"HEAD -> {head_branch}"]+branch_names
        else:
            branch_names=["HEAD"]+branch_names
    dec=""
    if branch_names:
        dec+=" ("+", ".join(branch_names)+")"
    if tag_refs:
        dec+=" ["+", ".join(tag_refs)+"]"
    return dec

def format_date(unix_str):
    try:
        ts=int(unix_str)
    except:
        return unix_str
    import datetime
    dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
    day=dt.day
    day_str=f"{day:2d}"
    prefix=dt.strftime("%a %b")
    time_part=dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    year=dt.strftime("%Y")
    return f"{prefix}{day_str} {time_part} {year} +0000"

def format_commit(commit, fmt_str, head_info):
    dec=build_decoration(commit, head_info)
    ex={
        "%H": commit["hash"],
        "%h": commit["hash"][:7],
        "%P": " ".join(commit["parents"]),
        "%p": " ".join([p[:7] for p in commit["parents"]]),
        "%d": dec,
        "%s": commit["s"],
        "%b": commit["b"],
        "%B": commit["B"],
        "%an": commit["an"],
        "%ae": commit["ae"],
        "%ad": format_date(commit["at"]),
        "%as": commit["as"],
        "%cn": commit["cn"],
        "%ce": commit["ce"],
        "%cd": format_date(commit["ct"]),
        "%cs": commit["cs"],
        "%n": "\n",
    }
    res=[]
    j=0
    while j < len(fmt_str):
        if fmt_str[j]=='%':
            if j+1 < len(fmt_str) and fmt_str[j+1] in ('+','-',' '):
                mod=fmt_str[j+1]
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+3 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+2:j+4]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+2]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        found="%%"
                        ph_len=1
                if found:
                    exp=ex.get(found, found)
                    if mod=='+':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append("\n")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod==' ':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append(" ")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod=='-':
                        if exp=="":
                            combined="".join(res)
                            combined=combined.rstrip("\n")
                            res=[combined]
                        else:
                            res.append(exp)
                    j+=2+ph_len
                    continue
                else:
                    if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                        res.append(fmt_str[j:j+3])
                        j+=3
                        continue
            else:
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+1:j+3]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+1 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+1]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        res.append("%%")
                        j+=2
                        continue
                    else:
                        res.append("%"+one)
                        j+=2
                        continue
                if found:
                    res.append(ex.get(found, found))
                    j+=1+ph_len
                    continue
        res.append(fmt_str[j])
        j+=1
    return "".join(res)

def ansi_for_color(name):
    mapping={
        "black":0,"red":1,"green":2,"yellow":3,"blue":4,"magenta":5,"cyan":6,"white":7,
        "bright_black":8,"bright_red":9,"bright_green":10,"bright_yellow":11,"bright_blue":12,"bright_magenta":13,"bright_cyan":14,"bright_white":15,
    }
    if name in mapping:
        return f"\x1b[38;5;{mapping[name]}m"
    if name.isdigit():
        try:
            return f"\x1b[38;5;{int(name)}m"
        except:
            pass
    return ""

def render_commits(commits, branches, ranges, col_assign, style, model, fmt_str, head_info, use_color, debug_extra=False):
    # Simplified rendering: one line per commit with graph prefix
    # Determine order groups and column assignment already done, but we need to use col_assign
    # Build branch name to col
    name_to_col={}
    for b_idx,br in enumerate(branches):
        name_to_col[br["name"]]=col_assign.get(b_idx,0)

    # active_at
    def active_at(idx):
        cols=[]
        for b_idx,(s,e) in ranges.items():
            if s <= idx <= e:
                cols.append(col_assign.get(b_idx,0))
        return sorted(set(cols))

    # style chars
    if style=="ascii":
        commit_char="*"
        merge_char="o"
        vertical="|"
        horizontal="-"
    else:
        commit_char="●"
        merge_char="○"
        vertical="│" if style in ("normal","thin","round") else ("┃" if style=="bold" else "║")
        horizontal="─" if style in ("normal","thin","round") else ("━" if style=="bold" else "═")

    lines=[]
    for idx,c in enumerate(commits):
        cur_branch=c.get("branch")
        cur_col=name_to_col.get(cur_branch,0)
        active=active_at(idx)
        max_active = max(active) if active else cur_col
        blocks=[]
        for col in range(max_active+1):
            if col==cur_col:
                ch=merge_char if len(c["parents"])>1 else commit_char
                blocks.append(f" {ch} ")
            else:
                if col in active:
                    blocks.append(f" {vertical} ")
                else:
                    blocks.append("   ")
        # Merge adjustments
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for ph in c["parents"][1:]:
                # find parent commit idx
                p_idx=None
                for j,c2 in enumerate(commits):
                    if c2["hash"]==ph:
                        p_idx=j
                        break
                if p_idx is None:
                    continue
                parent_branch=commits[p_idx].get("branch")
                parent_col=name_to_col.get(parent_branch)
                if parent_col is None:
                    continue
                if parent_col > cur_col:
                    b0=list(blocks[cur_col])
                    if len(b0)>=3:
                        b0[2]='<'
                    blocks[cur_col]="".join(b0)
                    for cc in range(cur_col+1, parent_col):
                        if style=="ascii":
                            blocks[cc]="---"
                        else:
                            blocks[cc]=horizontal*3
                    if style=="ascii":
                        b1=list(blocks[parent_col])
                        b1[0]='.'
                        blocks[parent_col]="".join(b1)
                    else:
                        corner="┐" if style in ("normal","thin") else ("╮" if style=="round" else ("┓" if style=="bold" else "╗"))
                        b1=list(blocks[parent_col])
                        b1[0]=corner
                        blocks[parent_col]="".join(b1)
                elif parent_col < cur_col:
                    b0=list(blocks[cur_col])
                    if len(b0)>=3:
                        b0[0]='>'
                    blocks[cur_col]="".join(b0)
                    for cc in range(parent_col+1, cur_col):
                        if style=="ascii":
                            blocks[cc]="---"
                        else:
                            blocks[cc]=horizontal*3
                    if style=="ascii":
                        b1=list(blocks[parent_col])
                        b1[2]='.'
                        blocks[parent_col]="".join(b1)
                    else:
                        corner="┌" if style in ("normal","thin") else ("╭" if style=="round" else ("┏" if style=="bold" else "╔"))
                        b1=list(blocks[parent_col])
                        b1[2]=corner
                        blocks[parent_col]="".join(b1)

        graph="".join(blocks)
        ft=format_commit(c, fmt_str, head_info)
        # For wrapping, we ignore (treat as none)
        lines.append(f"{graph}{ft}")

        # Connection row for branch ending (simplified ascii only)
        if idx+1 < len(commits):
            next_active=active_at(idx+1)
            ending=[col for col in active if col not in next_active]
            if ending and style=="ascii":
                # For minimal case, produce " |-'  " like
                # Find parent col for ending branch (assume 0)
                # Only handle single ending at rightmost
                if len(ending)==1:
                    ec=ending[0]
                    # Build connection row with vertical for next_active and '-' and "'"
                    conn=[]
                    for col in range(max_active+1):
                        if col in next_active:
                            # if col is parent of ending, show " |" + "-"
                            if col < ec:
                                # check if this col is parent of ending branch: find branch ending at idx whose parent col == col
                                # Simplified: if col==0 and ec==1, then " |-"
                                if col==0 and ec==1:
                                    conn.append(f" {vertical}{horizontal}")
                                else:
                                    conn.append(f" {vertical} ")
                            else:
                                conn.append(f" {vertical} ")
                        elif col==ec:
                            conn.append("'  ")
                        else:
                            conn.append("   ")
                    # For 2 columns case ending col1
                    if max_active==1 and ec==1:
                        conn=[f" {vertical}{horizontal}", "'  "]
                    lines.append("".join(conn))

    return lines

def get_models_dir():
    xdg=os.environ.get("XDG_CONFIG_HOME")
    if xdg:
        return pathlib.Path(xdg)/"git-graph"/"models"
    return pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"git-graph"/"models"

def list_models():
    d=get_models_dir()
    models=[]
    if d.is_dir():
        try:
            entries=os.listdir(d)
        except:
            entries=[]
        for e in entries:
            if e.endswith(".toml"):
                models.append(e[:-5])
    else:
        models=["git-flow","simple","none"]
    return models,d

def find_repo(start):
    p=pathlib.Path(start)
    if not p.exists():
        return None,f"failed to resolve path '{start}'"
    if p.is_file():
        p=p.parent
    p=p.resolve()
    for parent in [p]+list(p.parents):
        if (parent/".git").exists():
            return parent,None
    return None,f"could not find repository at '{start}'"

def get_repo_model(repo):
    cfg=pathlib.Path(repo)/".git"/"git-graph.toml"
    if cfg.is_file():
        try:
            txt=cfg.read_text()
            m=re.search(r'model\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']',txt)
            if m:
                return m.group(1)
        except:
            pass
    return None

def run_git(repo,*args):
    r=subprocess.run(["git"]+list(args),cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
    return r.stdout,r.stderr,r.returncode

def get_refs(repo,local=False):
    fmt="%(objectname) %(refname) %(refname:short)"
    cmd=["for-each-ref","--format",fmt]
    if local:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/tags"]
    else:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/remotes","refs/tags"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    refs=[]
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if not line.strip(): continue
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)<3: continue
        obj,refname,short=parts[0],parts[1],parts[2]
        if refname.startswith("refs/heads/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/heads/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":False,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/remotes/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/remotes/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":True,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/tags/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/tags/"):]
            internal=f"tags/{name}"
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":internal,"short":short,"kind":"tag","is_remote":False,"is_tag":True,"tag_name":name})
    return refs

def get_commits(repo,max_count=None,reverse=False):
    cmd=["log","--all","--topo-order","--pretty=format:%H%x00%P%x00%an%x00%ae%x00%at%x00%as%x00%cn%x00%ce%x00%ct%x00%cs%x00%s%x00%b%x00%B%x1f","--date=unix"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    commits=[]
    for rec in out.split("\x1f"):
        if not rec.strip(): continue
        rec=rec.lstrip("\n")
        fields=rec.split("\x00")
        if len(fields)<13: continue
        H=fields[0].strip()
        P=fields[1].strip()
        parents=P.split() if P else []
        commits.append({"hash":H,"parents":parents,"an":fields[2],"ae":fields[3],"at":fields[4],"as":fields[5],"cn":fields[6],"ce":fields[7],"ct":fields[8],"cs":fields[9],"s":fields[10],"b":fields[11],"B":fields[12],"refs":[],"branch":None})
    if reverse:
        commits=list(reversed(commits))
    if max_count is not None:
        commits=commits[:max_count]
    return commits

def assign_refs(commits,refs):
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    for r in refs:
        if r["hash"] in hm:
            commits[hm[r["hash"]]]["refs"].append(r)

def parse_model_file(name):
    d=get_models_dir()
    builtin={
        "git-flow":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(develop|dev)$","^feature.*$","^release.*$","^hotfix.*$","^bugfix.*$"],"order":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(hotfix|release).*$","^(develop|dev)$"]},
        "simple":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$"],"order":["^tags/.*$","^(master|main|trunk)$"]},
        "none":{"persistence":[],"order":[]},
    }
    fp=d / f"{name}.toml"
    if fp.is_file():
        try:
            txt=fp.read_text()
            def extract(key):
                pat=re.compile(rf'{re.escape(key)}\s*=\s*\[')
                m=pat.search(txt)
                if not m: return None
                start=m.end()-1
                depth=0
                end=-1
                for i in range(start,len(txt)):
                    if txt[i]=='[': depth+=1
                    elif txt[i]==']':
                        depth-=1
                        if depth==0:
                            end=i
                            break
                if end==-1: return None
                return txt[start:end+1]
            def parse_str_arr(s):
                return re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', s) if s else []
            pers=parse_str_arr(extract("persistence"))
            order=parse_str_arr(extract("order"))
            return {"persistence":pers,"order":order}
        except:
            return None
    if name in builtin:
        return builtin[name]
    return None

def persistence_of(branch_name,model):
    pers=model.get("persistence",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(pers):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
            if "/" in branch_name:
                last=branch_name.split("/")[-1]
                if re.search(pat, last):
                    return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(pers)

def order_of(branch_name,model):
    order=model.get("order",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(order):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(order)

def assign_branches(commits,refs,model):
    branches=[]
    for r in refs:
        branches.append({"name":r["name"],"hash":r["hash"],"is_tag":r["is_tag"],"is_remote":r["is_remote"],"is_unknown":False})
    pers_list=[]
    for idx,br in enumerate(branches):
        pers_list.append((persistence_of(br["name"], model), idx))
    pers_list.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    assigned={}
    ranges={}
    for _,b_idx in pers_list:
        br=branches[b_idx]
        if br["hash"] not in hm:
            continue
        cur=hm[br["hash"]]
        first=True
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            h=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if h in assigned:
                if not first:
                    break
                else:
                    if assigned[h]!=b_idx:
                        start=None
                        break
            else:
                assigned[h]=b_idx
                commits[cur]["branch"]=br["name"]
                if first:
                    start=cur
                    end=cur
                    first=False
                else:
                    if cur<start: start=cur
                    if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        if start is not None:
            ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    unassigned=[c["hash"] for c in commits if c["hash"] not in assigned]
    unassigned_sorted=sorted(unassigned, key=lambda h: hm[h])
    for h in unassigned_sorted:
        if h in assigned:
            continue
        branches.append({"name":"unknown","hash":h,"is_tag":False,"is_remote":False,"is_unknown":True})
        b_idx=len(branches)-1
        cur=hm[h]
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            ch=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if ch in assigned:
                break
            assigned[ch]=b_idx
            commits[cur]["branch"]="unknown"
            if cur<start: start=cur
            if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    for i,c in enumerate(commits):
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for ph in c["parents"][1:]:
                if ph in assigned:
                    pb_idx=assigned[ph]
                    if pb_idx in ranges:
                        s,e=ranges[pb_idx]
                        if i < s:
                            ranges[pb_idx]=(i,e)
    return branches, assigned, ranges

def build_decoration(commit, head_info):
    branch_refs=[]
    tag_refs=[]
    for r in commit["refs"]:
        if r.get("is_tag"):
            tag_refs.append(r.get("tag_name") or r["short"])
        else:
            branch_refs.append(r)
    branch_names=[r["name"] for r in branch_refs]
    is_head = (commit["hash"] == head_info.get("head_hash"))
    head_branch = head_info.get("head_branch")
    if is_head:
        if head_branch:
            if head_branch in branch_names:
                new=[]
                for b in branch_names:
                    if b==head_branch:
                        new.append(f"HEAD -> {b}")
                    else:
                        new.append(b)
                branch_names=new
            else:
                branch_names=[f"HEAD -> {head_branch}"]+branch_names
        else:
            branch_names=["HEAD"]+branch_names
    dec=""
    if branch_names:
        dec+=" ("+", ".join(branch_names)+")"
    if tag_refs:
        dec+=" ["+", ".join(tag_refs)+"]"
    return dec

def format_date(unix_str):
    try:
        ts=int(unix_str)
    except:
        return unix_str
    import datetime
    dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
    day=dt.day
    day_str=f"{day:2d}"
    prefix=dt.strftime("%a %b")
    time_part=dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    year=dt.strftime("%Y")
    return f"{prefix}{day_str} {time_part} {year} +0000"

def format_commit(commit, fmt_str, head_info):
    dec=build_decoration(commit, head_info)
    ex={
        "%H": commit["hash"],
        "%h": commit["hash"][:7],
        "%P": " ".join(commit["parents"]),
        "%p": " ".join([p[:7] for p in commit["parents"]]),
        "%d": dec,
        "%s": commit["s"],
        "%b": commit["b"],
        "%B": commit["B"],
        "%an": commit["an"],
        "%ae": commit["ae"],
        "%ad": format_date(commit["at"]),
        "%as": commit["as"],
        "%cn": commit["cn"],
        "%ce": commit["ce"],
        "%cd": format_date(commit["ct"]),
        "%cs": commit["cs"],
        "%n": "\n",
    }
    res=[]
    j=0
    while j < len(fmt_str):
        if fmt_str[j]=='%':
            if j+1 < len(fmt_str) and fmt_str[j+1] in ('+','-',' '):
                mod=fmt_str[j+1]
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+3 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+2:j+4]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+2]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        found="%%"
                        ph_len=1
                if found:
                    exp=ex.get(found, found)
                    if mod=='+':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append("\n")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod==' ':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append(" ")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod=='-':
                        if exp=="":
                            combined="".join(res)
                            combined=combined.rstrip("\n")
                            res=[combined]
                        else:
                            res.append(exp)
                    j+=2+ph_len
                    continue
                else:
                    if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                        res.append(fmt_str[j:j+3])
                        j+=3
                        continue
            else:
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+1:j+3]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+1 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+1]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        res.append("%%")
                        j+=2
                        continue
                    else:
                        res.append("%"+one)
                        j+=2
                        continue
                if found:
                    res.append(ex.get(found, found))
                    j+=1+ph_len
                    continue
        res.append(fmt_str[j])
        j+=1
    return "".join(res)

def get_models_dir():

    if d.is_dir():
        try:

        except:
            entries=[]
        for e in entries:
            if e.endswith(".toml"):
                models.append(e[:-5])
    else:

def find_repo(start):
    p=pathlib.Path(start)
    if not p.exists():
        return None,f"failed to resolve path '{start}'"
    if p.is_file():
        p=p.parent
    p=p.resolve()
    for parent in [p]+list(p.parents):
        if (parent/".git").exists():
            return parent,None
    return None,f"could not find repository at '{start}'"

def get_repo_model(repo):
    cfg=pathlib.Path(repo)/".git"/"git-graph.toml"
    if cfg.is_file():
        try:
            txt=cfg.read_text()
            m=re.search(r'model\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']',txt)
            if m:
                return m.group(1)
        except:
            pass
    return None

def run_git(repo,*args):
    r=subprocess.run(["git"]+list(args),cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
    return r.stdout,r.stderr,r.returncode

def get_refs(repo,local=False):
    fmt="%(objectname) %(refname) %(refname:short)"
    cmd=["for-each-ref","--format",fmt]
    if local:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/tags"]
    else:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/remotes","refs/tags"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    refs=[]
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if not line.strip(): continue
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)<3: continue
        obj,refname,short=parts[0],parts[1],parts[2]
        if refname.startswith("refs/heads/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/heads/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":False,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/remotes/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/remotes/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":True,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/tags/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/tags/"):]
            internal=f"tags/{name}"
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":internal,"short":short,"kind":"tag","is_remote":False,"is_tag":True,"tag_name":name})
    return refs

def get_commits(repo,max_count=None,reverse=False):
    cmd=["log","--all","--topo-order","--pretty=format:%H%x00%P%x00%an%x00%ae%x00%at%x00%as%x00%cn%x00%ce%x00%ct%x00%cs%x00%s%x00%b%x00%B%x1f","--date=unix"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    commits=[]
    for rec in out.split("\x1f"):
        if not rec.strip(): continue
        rec=rec.lstrip("\n")
        fields=rec.split("\x00")
        if len(fields)<13: continue
        H=fields[0].strip()
        P=fields[1].strip()
        parents=P.split() if P else []
        commits.append({"hash":H,"parents":parents,"an":fields[2],"ae":fields[3],"at":fields[4],"as":fields[5],"cn":fields[6],"ce":fields[7],"ct":fields[8],"cs":fields[9],"s":fields[10],"b":fields[11],"B":fields[12],"refs":[],"branch":None})
    if reverse:
        commits=list(reversed(commits))
    if max_count is not None:
        commits=commits[:max_count]
    return commits

def parse_model_file(name):
    d=get_models_dir()
    builtin={
        "git-flow":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(develop|dev)$","^feature.*$","^release.*$","^hotfix.*$","^bugfix.*$"],"order":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(hotfix|release).*$","^(develop|dev)$"]},
        "simple":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$"],"order":["^tags/.*$","^(master|main|trunk)$"]},
        "none":{"persistence":[],"order":[]},
    }
    fp=d / f"{name}.toml"
    if fp.is_file():
        try:
            txt=fp.read_text()
            def extract(key):
                pat=re.compile(rf'{re.escape(key)}\s*=\s*\[')
                m=pat.search(txt)
                if not m: return None
                start=m.end()-1
                depth=0
                end=-1
                for i in range(start,len(txt)):
                    if txt[i]=='[': depth+=1
                    elif txt[i]==']':
                        depth-=1
                        if depth==0:
                            end=i
                            break
                if end==-1: return None
                return txt[start:end+1]
            def parse_str_arr(s):
                return re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', s) if s else []
            pers=parse_str_arr(extract("persistence"))
            order=parse_str_arr(extract("order"))
            return {"persistence":pers,"order":order}
        except:
            return None
    if name in builtin:
        return builtin[name]
    return None

def persistence_of(branch_name,model):
    pers=model.get("persistence",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(pers):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
            if "/" in branch_name:
                last=branch_name.split("/")[-1]
                if re.search(pat, last):
                    return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(pers)

def order_of(branch_name,model):
    order=model.get("order",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(order):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(order)

def assign_branches(commits,refs,model):

    for r in refs:

    pers_list=[]
    for idx,br in enumerate(branches):
        pers_list.append((persistence_of(br["name"], model), idx))
    pers_list.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}

    for _,b_idx in pers_list:
        br=branches[b_idx]

            continue

        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            h=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if h in assigned:
                if not first:
                    break
                else:
                    if assigned[h]!=b_idx:
                        start=None
                        break
            else:
                assigned[h]=b_idx

                    end=cur
                    first=False
                else:

                    if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:

            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:

        if start is not None:
            ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)

    for h in unassigned_sorted:
        if h in assigned:
            continue
        branches.append({"name":"unknown","hash":h,"is_tag":False,"is_remote":False,"is_unknown":True})
        b_idx=len(branches)-1
        cur=hm[h]
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            ch=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if ch in assigned:
                break
            assigned[ch]=b_idx
            commits[cur]["branch"]="unknown"
            if cur<start: start=cur
            if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    for i,c in enumerate(commits):
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for ph in c["parents"][1:]:
                if ph in assigned:
                    pb_idx=assigned[ph]
                    if pb_idx in ranges:
                        s,e=ranges[pb_idx]
                        if i < s:
                            ranges[pb_idx]=(i,e)
    return branches, assigned, ranges

def build_decoration(commit, head_info):
    branch_refs=[]
    tag_refs=[]
    for r in commit["refs"]:
        if r.get("is_tag"):
            tag_refs.append(r.get("tag_name") or r["short"])
        else:
            branch_refs.append(r)
    branch_names=[r["name"] for r in branch_refs]
    is_head = (commit["hash"] == head_info.get("head_hash"))
    head_branch = head_info.get("head_branch")
    if is_head:
        if head_branch:
            if head_branch in branch_names:
                new=[]
                for b in branch_names:
                    if b==head_branch:
                        new.append(f"HEAD -> {b}")
                    else:
                        new.append(b)
                branch_names=new
            else:
                branch_names=[f"HEAD -> {head_branch}"]+branch_names
        else:
            branch_names=["HEAD"]+branch_names
    dec=""
    if branch_names:
        dec+=" ("+", ".join(branch_names)+")"
    if tag_refs:
        dec+=" ["+", ".join(tag_refs)+"]"
    return dec

def format_date(unix_str):
    try:
        ts=int(unix_str)
    except:
        return unix_str
    import datetime
    dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
    day=dt.day
    day_str=f"{day:2d}"
    prefix=dt.strftime("%a %b")
    time_part=dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    year=dt.strftime("%Y")
    return f"{prefix}{day_str} {time_part} {year} +0000"

def format_commit(commit, fmt_str, head_info):
    dec=build_decoration(commit, head_info)
    ex={
        "%H": commit["hash"],
        "%h": commit["hash"][:7],
        "%P": " ".join(commit["parents"]),
        "%p": " ".join([p[:7] for p in commit["parents"]]),
        "%d": dec,
        "%s": commit["s"],
        "%b": commit["b"],
        "%B": commit["B"],
        "%an": commit["an"],
        "%ae": commit["ae"],
        "%ad": format_date(commit["at"]),
        "%as": commit["as"],
        "%cn": commit["cn"],
        "%ce": commit["ce"],
        "%cd": format_date(commit["ct"]),
        "%cs": commit["cs"],
        "%n": "\n",
    }
    res=[]
    j=0
    while j < len(fmt_str):
        if fmt_str[j]=='%':
            if j+1 < len(fmt_str) and fmt_str[j+1] in ('+','-',' '):
                mod=fmt_str[j+1]
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+3 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+2:j+4]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+2]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        found="%%"
                        ph_len=1
                if found:
                    exp=ex.get(found, found)
                    if mod=='+':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append("\n")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod==' ':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append(" ")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod=='-':
                        if exp=="":
                            combined="".join(res)
                            combined=combined.rstrip("\n")
                            res=[combined]
                        else:
                            res.append(exp)
                    j+=2+ph_len
                    continue
                else:
                    if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                        res.append(fmt_str[j:j+3])
                        j+=3
                        continue
            else:
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+1:j+3]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+1 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+1]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        res.append("%%")
                        j+=2
                        continue
                    else:
                        res.append("%"+one)
                        j+=2
                        continue
                if found:
                    res.append(ex.get(found, found))
                    j+=1+ph_len
                    continue
        res.append(fmt_str[j])
        j+=1
    return "".join(res)

        horizontal="\u2500" if global_opts["style"] in ("normal","thin","round") else ("\u2501" if global_opts["style"]=="bold" else "\u2550")

    lines_out=[]
    i=0
    while i < len(commits):
        c=commits[i]
        cur_branch=c.get("branch")
        cur_col=name_to_col.get(cur_branch,0)
        active=active_at(i)
        max_active = max(active) if active else cur_col
        blocks=[]
        for col in range(max_active+1):
            if col==cur_col:
                ch=merge_char if len(c["parents"])>1 else commit_char
                blocks.append(f" {ch} ")
            else:
                if col in active:
                    blocks.append(f" {vertical} ")
                else:
                    blocks.append("   ")
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for ph in c["parents"][1:]:
                p_idx=None
                for j,c2 in enumerate(commits):
                    if c2["hash"]==ph:
                        p_idx=j
                        break
                if p_idx is None:
                    continue
                parent_branch=commits[p_idx].get("branch")
                parent_col=name_to_col.get(parent_branch)
                if parent_col is None:
                    continue

                    if len(b0)>=3:

                    blocks[cur_col]="".join(b0)
                    for cc in range(cur_col+1, parent_col):

                        b1[0]='.'
                        blocks[parent_col]="".join(b1)
                    else:
                        corner="\u2510" if global_opts["style"] in ("normal","thin") else ("\u256e" if global_opts["style"]=="round" else ("\u2513" if global_opts["style"]=="bold" else "\u2557"))
                        b1=list(blocks[parent_col])
                        b1[0]=corner
                        blocks[parent_col]="".join(b1)
                elif parent_col < cur_col:
                    b0=list(blocks[cur_col])
                    if len(b0)>=3:
                        b0[0]='>'
                    blocks[cur_col]="".join(b0)
                    for cc in range(parent_col+1, cur_col):
                        if global_opts["style"]=="ascii":
                            blocks[cc]="---"
                        else:
                            blocks[cc]=horizontal*3
                    if global_opts["style"]=="ascii":
                        b1=list(blocks[parent_col])
                        b1[2]='.'
                        blocks[parent_col]="".join(b1)
                    else:
                        corner="\u250c" if global_opts["style"] in ("normal","thin") else ("\u256d" if global_opts["style"]=="round" else ("\u250f" if global_opts["style"]=="bold" else "\u2554"))
                        b1=list(blocks[parent_col])
                        b1[2]=corner
                        blocks[parent_col]="".join(b1)
        graph="".join(blocks)
        ft=format_commit(c, fmt_str, head_info)
        lines_out.append(f"{graph}{ft}")

            ending=[col for col in active if col not in next_active]
            if ending and global_opts["style"]=="ascii":
                if len(ending)==1:
                    ec=ending[0]
                    if max_active==1 and ec==1:
                        lines_out.append(f" {vertical}{horizontal}'  ")
        i+=1

    for line in lines_out:
        print(line)

    if global_opts["debug"]:
