    return pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"git-graph"/"models"

def list_models():
    d=get_models_dir()
    models=[]
    if d.is_dir():
        try:
            entries=os.listdir(d)
        except:
            entries=[]
        for e in entries:
            if e.endswith(".toml"):
                models.append(e[:-5])
    else:
        models=["git-flow","simple","none"]
    return models,d

def find_repo(start):
    p=pathlib.Path(start)
    if not p.exists():
        return None,f"failed to resolve path '{start}'"
    if p.is_file():
        p=p.parent
    p=p.resolve()
    for parent in [p]+list(p.parents):
        if (parent/".git").exists():
            return parent,None
    return None,f"could not find repository at '{start}'"

def get_repo_model(repo):
    cfg=pathlib.Path(repo)/".git"/"git-graph.toml"
    if cfg.is_file():
        try:
            txt=cfg.read_text()
            m=re.search(r'model\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']',txt)
            if m:
                return m.group(1)
        except:
            pass
    return None

def run_git(repo,*args):
    r=subprocess.run(["git"]+list(args),cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
    return r.stdout,r.stderr,r.returncode

def get_refs(repo,local=False):
    fmt="%(objectname) %(refname) %(refname:short)"
    cmd=["for-each-ref","--format",fmt]
    if local:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/tags"]
    else:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/remotes","refs/tags"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    refs=[]
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if not line.strip(): continue
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)<3: continue
        obj,refname,short=parts[0],parts[1],parts[2]
        if refname.startswith("refs/heads/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/heads/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":False,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/remotes/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/remotes/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":True,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/tags/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/tags/"):]
            internal=f"tags/{name}"
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":internal,"short":short,"kind":"tag","is_remote":False,"is_tag":True,"tag_name":name})
    return refs

def get_commits(repo,max_count=None,reverse=False):
    cmd=["log","--all","--date-order","--pretty=format:%H%x00%P%x00%an%x00%ae%x00%at%x00%as%x00%cn%x00%ce%x00%ct%x00%cs%x00%s%x00%b%x00%B%x1f","--date=unix"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    commits=[]
    for rec in out.split("\x1f"):
        if not rec.strip(): continue
        rec=rec.lstrip("\n")
        fields=rec.split("\x00")
        if len(fields)<13: continue
        H=fields[0].strip()
        P=fields[1].strip()
        parents=P.split() if P else []
        commits.append({"hash":H,"parents":parents,"an":fields[2],"ae":fields[3],"at":fields[4],"as":fields[5],"cn":fields[6],"ce":fields[7],"ct":fields[8],"cs":fields[9],"s":fields[10],"b":fields[11],"B":fields[12],"refs":[],"branch":None})
    if reverse:
        commits=list(reversed(commits))
    if max_count is not None:
        commits=commits[:max_count]
    return commits

def assign_refs(commits,refs):
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    for r in refs:
        if r["hash"] in hm:
            commits[hm[r["hash"]]]["refs"].append(r)

def parse_model_file(name):
    d=get_models_dir()
    builtin={
        "git-flow":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(develop|dev)$","^feature.*$","^release.*$","^hotfix.*$","^bugfix.*$"],"order":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(hotfix|release).*$","^(develop|dev)$"]},
        "simple":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$"],"order":["^tags/.*$","^(master|main|trunk)$"]},
        "none":{"persistence":[],"order":[]},
    }
    fp=d / f"{name}.toml"
    if fp.is_file():
        try:
            txt=fp.read_text()
            def extract(key):
                pat=re.compile(rf'{re.escape(key)}\s*=\s*\[')
                m=pat.search(txt)
                if not m: return None
                start=m.end()-1
                depth=0
                end=-1
                for i in range(start,len(txt)):
                    if txt[i]=='[': depth+=1
                    elif txt[i]==']':
                        depth-=1
                        if depth==0:
                            end=i
                            break
                if end==-1: return None
                return txt[start:end+1]
            def parse_str_arr(s):
                return re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', s) if s else []
            pers=parse_str_arr(extract("persistence"))
            order=parse_str_arr(extract("order"))
            return {"persistence":pers,"order":order}
        except:
            return None
    if name in builtin:
        return builtin[name]
    return None

def persistence_of(branch_name,model):
    pers=model.get("persistence",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(pers):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
            if "/" in branch_name:
                last=branch_name.split("/")[-1]
                if re.search(pat, last):
                    return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(pers)

def order_of(branch_name,model):
    order=model.get("order",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(order):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(order)

def assign_branches(commits,refs,model):
    branches=[]
    for r in refs:
        branches.append({"name":r["name"],"hash":r["hash"],"is_tag":r["is_tag"],"is_remote":r["is_remote"],"is_unknown":False})
    pers_list=[]
    for idx,br in enumerate(branches):
        pers_list.append((persistence_of(br["name"], model), idx))
    pers_list.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    assigned={}
    ranges={}
    for _,b_idx in pers_list:
        br=branches[b_idx]
        if br["hash"] not in hm:
            continue
        cur=hm[br["hash"]]
        first=True
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            h=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if h in assigned:
                if not first:
                    break
                else:
                    if assigned[h]!=b_idx:
                        start=None
                        break
            else:
                assigned[h]=b_idx
                commits[cur]["branch"]=br["name"]
                if first:
                    start=cur
                    end=cur
                    first=False
                else:
                    if cur<start: start=cur
                    if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        if start is not None:
            ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    unassigned=[c["hash"] for c in commits if c["hash"] not in assigned]
    unassigned_sorted=sorted(unassigned, key=lambda h: hm[h])
    for h in unassigned_sorted:
        if h in assigned:
            continue
        branches.append({"name":"unknown","hash":h,"is_tag":False,"is_remote":False,"is_unknown":True})
        b_idx=len(branches)-1
        cur=hm[h]
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            ch=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if ch in assigned:
                break
            assigned[ch]=b_idx
            commits[cur]["branch"]="unknown"
            if cur<start: start=cur
            if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    for i,c in enumerate(commits):
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for ph in c["parents"][1:]:
                if ph in assigned:
                    pb_idx=assigned[ph]
                    if pb_idx in ranges:
                        s,e=ranges[pb_idx]
                        ns=min(s,i)
                        ne=max(e,i)
                        ranges[pb_idx]=(ns,ne)
    return branches, assigned, ranges

def build_decoration(commit, head_info):
    branch_refs=[]
    tag_refs=[]
    for r in commit["refs"]:
        if r.get("is_tag"):
            tag_refs.append(r.get("tag_name") or r["short"])
        else:
            branch_refs.append(r)
    branch_names=[r["name"] for r in branch_refs]
    is_head = (commit["hash"] == head_info.get("head_hash"))
    head_branch = head_info.get("head_branch")
    if is_head:
        if head_branch:
            if head_branch in branch_names:
                new=[]
                for b in branch_names:
                    if b==head_branch:
                        new.append(f"HEAD -> {b}")
                    else:
                        new.append(b)
                branch_names=new
            else:
                branch_names=[f"HEAD -> {head_branch}"]+branch_names
        else:
            branch_names=["HEAD"]+branch_names
    dec=""
    if branch_names:
        dec+=" ("+", ".join(branch_names)+")"
    if tag_refs:
        dec+=" ["+", ".join(tag_refs)+"]"
    return dec

def format_date(unix_str):
    try:
        ts=int(unix_str)
    except:
        return unix_str
    import datetime
    dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
    day=dt.day
    day_str=f"{day:2d}"
    prefix=dt.strftime("%a %b")
    time_part=dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    year=dt.strftime("%Y")
    return f"{prefix}{day_str} {time_part} {year} +0000"

def format_commit(commit, fmt_str, head_info):
    dec=build_decoration(commit, head_info)
    ex={
        "%H": commit["hash"],
        "%h": commit["hash"][:7],
        "%P": " ".join(commit["parents"]),
        "%p": " ".join([p[:7] for p in commit["parents"]]),
        "%d": dec,
        "%s": commit["s"],
        "%b": commit["b"],
        "%B": commit["B"],
        "%an": commit["an"],
        "%ae": commit["ae"],
        "%ad": format_date(commit["at"]),
        "%as": commit["as"],
        "%cn": commit["cn"],
        "%ce": commit["ce"],
        "%cd": format_date(commit["ct"]),
        "%cs": commit["cs"],
        "%n": "\n",
    }
    res=[]
    j=0
    while j < len(fmt_str):
        if fmt_str[j]=='%':
            if j+1 < len(fmt_str) and fmt_str[j+1] in ('+','-',' '):
                mod=fmt_str[j+1]
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+3 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+2:j+4]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+2]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        found="%%"
                        ph_len=1
                if found:
                    exp=ex.get(found, found)
                    if mod=='+':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append("\n")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod==' ':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append(" ")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod=='-':
                        if exp=="":
                            combined="".join(res)
                            combined=combined.rstrip("\n")
                            res=[combined]
                        else:
                            res.append(exp)
                    j+=2+ph_len
                    continue
                else:
                    if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                        res.append(fmt_str[j:j+3])
                        j+=3
                        continue
            else:
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+1:j+3]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+1 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+1]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        res.append("%%")
                        j+=2
                        continue
                    else:
                        res.append("%"+one)
                        j+=2
                        continue
                if found:
                    res.append(ex.get(found, found))
                    j+=1+ph_len
                    continue
        res.append(fmt_str[j])
        j+=1
    return "".join(res)

def main():

    p=pathlib.Path(start)
    if not p.exists():
        return None,f"failed to resolve path '{start}'"
    if p.is_file():
        p=p.parent
    p=p.resolve()
    for parent in [p]+list(p.parents):
        if (parent/".git").exists():
            return parent,None
    return None,f"could not find repository at '{start}'"

def get_repo_model(repo):
    cfg=pathlib.Path(repo)/".git"/"git-graph.toml"
    if cfg.is_file():
        try:
            txt=cfg.read_text()
            m=re.search(r'model\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']',txt)
            if m:
                return m.group(1)
        except:
            pass
    return None

def run_git(repo,*args):
    r=subprocess.run(["git"]+list(args),cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
    return r.stdout,r.stderr,r.returncode

def get_refs(repo,local=False):
    fmt="%(objectname) %(refname) %(refname:short)"
    cmd=["for-each-ref","--format",fmt]
    if local:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/tags"]
    else:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/remotes","refs/tags"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    refs=[]
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if not line.strip(): continue
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)<3: continue
        obj,refname,short=parts[0],parts[1],parts[2]
        if refname.startswith("refs/heads/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/heads/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":False,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/remotes/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/remotes/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":True,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/tags/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/tags/"):]
            internal=f"tags/{name}"
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":internal,"short":short,"kind":"tag","is_remote":False,"is_tag":True,"tag_name":name})
    return refs

def get_commits(repo,max_count=None,reverse=False):
    cmd=["log","--all","--date-order","--pretty=format:%H%x00%P%x00%an%x00%ae%x00%at%x00%as%x00%cn%x00%ce%x00%ct%x00%cs%x00%s%x00%b%x00%B%x1f","--date=unix"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    commits=[]
    for rec in out.split("\x1f"):
        if not rec.strip(): continue
        rec=rec.lstrip("\n")
        fields=rec.split("\x00")
        if len(fields)<13: continue
        H=fields[0].strip()
        P=fields[1].strip()
        parents=P.split() if P else []
        commits.append({"hash":H,"parents":parents,"an":fields[2],"ae":fields[3],"at":fields[4],"as":fields[5],"cn":fields[6],"ce":fields[7],"ct":fields[8],"cs":fields[9],"s":fields[10],"b":fields[11],"B":fields[12],"refs":[],"branch":None})
    if reverse:
        commits=list(reversed(commits))
    if max_count is not None:
        commits=commits[:max_count]
    return commits

def assign_refs(commits,refs):
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    for r in refs:
        if r["hash"] in hm:
            commits[hm[r["hash"]]]["refs"].append(r)

def parse_model_file(name):
    d=get_models_dir()
    builtin={
        "git-flow":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(develop|dev)$","^feature.*$","^release.*$","^hotfix.*$","^bugfix.*$"],"order":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(hotfix|release).*$","^(develop|dev)$"]},
        "simple":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$"],"order":["^tags/.*$","^(master|main|trunk)$"]},
        "none":{"persistence":[],"order":[]},
    }
    fp=d / f"{name}.toml"
    if fp.is_file():
        try:
            txt=fp.read_text()
            def extract(key):
                pat=re.compile(rf'{re.escape(key)}\s*=\s*\[')
                m=pat.search(txt)
                if not m: return None
                start=m.end()-1
                depth=0
                end=-1
                for i in range(start,len(txt)):
                    if txt[i]=='[': depth+=1
                    elif txt[i]==']':
                        depth-=1
                        if depth==0:
                            end=i
                            break
                if end==-1: return None
                return txt[start:end+1]
            def parse_str_arr(s):
                return re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', s) if s else []
            pers=parse_str_arr(extract("persistence"))
            order=parse_str_arr(extract("order"))
            return {"persistence":pers,"order":order}
        except:
            return None
    if name in builtin:
        return builtin[name]
    return None

def persistence_of(branch_name,model):
    pers=model.get("persistence",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(pers):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
            if "/" in branch_name:
                last=branch_name.split("/")[-1]
                if re.search(pat, last):
                    return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(pers)

def order_of(branch_name,model):
    order=model.get("order",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(order):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(order)

def assign_branches(commits,refs,model):
    branches=[]
    for r in refs:
        branches.append({"name":r["name"],"hash":r["hash"],"is_tag":r["is_tag"],"is_remote":r["is_remote"],"is_unknown":False})
    pers_list=[]
    for idx,br in enumerate(branches):
        pers_list.append((persistence_of(br["name"], model), idx))
    pers_list.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    assigned={}
    ranges={}
    for _,b_idx in pers_list:
        br=branches[b_idx]
        if br["hash"] not in hm:
            continue
        cur=hm[br["hash"]]
        first=True
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            h=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if h in assigned:
                if not first:
                    break
                else:
                    if assigned[h]!=b_idx:
                        start=None
                        break
            else:
                assigned[h]=b_idx
                commits[cur]["branch"]=br["name"]
                if first:
                    start=cur
                    end=cur
                    first=False
                else:
                    if cur<start: start=cur
                    if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        if start is not None:
            ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    unassigned=[c["hash"] for c in commits if c["hash"] not in assigned]
    unassigned_sorted=sorted(unassigned, key=lambda h: hm[h])
    for h in unassigned_sorted:
        if h in assigned:
            continue
        branches.append({"name":"unknown","hash":h,"is_tag":False,"is_remote":False,"is_unknown":True})
        b_idx=len(branches)-1
        cur=hm[h]
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            ch=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if ch in assigned:
                break
            assigned[ch]=b_idx
            commits[cur]["branch"]="unknown"
            if cur<start: start=cur
            if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    for i,c in enumerate(commits):
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for ph in c["parents"][1:]:
                if ph in assigned:
                    pb_idx=assigned[ph]
                    if pb_idx in ranges:
                        s,e=ranges[pb_idx]
                        ns=min(s,i)
                        ne=max(e,i)
                        ranges[pb_idx]=(ns,ne)
    return branches, assigned, ranges

def build_decoration(commit, head_info):
    branch_refs=[]
    tag_refs=[]
    for r in commit["refs"]:
        if r.get("is_tag"):
            tag_refs.append(r.get("tag_name") or r["short"])
        else:
            branch_refs.append(r)
    branch_names=[r["name"] for r in branch_refs]
    is_head = (commit["hash"] == head_info.get("head_hash"))
    head_branch = head_info.get("head_branch")
    if is_head:
        if head_branch:
            if head_branch in branch_names:
                new=[]
                for b in branch_names:
                    if b==head_branch:
                        new.append(f"HEAD -> {b}")
                    else:
                        new.append(b)
                branch_names=new
            else:
                branch_names=[f"HEAD -> {head_branch}"]+branch_names
        else:
            branch_names=["HEAD"]+branch_names
    dec=""
    if branch_names:
        dec+=" ("+", ".join(branch_names)+")"
    if tag_refs:
        dec+=" ["+", ".join(tag_refs)+"]"
    return dec

def format_date(unix_str):
    try:
        ts=int(unix_str)
    except:
        return unix_str
    import datetime
    dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
    day=dt.day
    day_str=f"{day:2d}"
    prefix=dt.strftime("%a %b")
    time_part=dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    year=dt.strftime("%Y")
    return f"{prefix}{day_str} {time_part} {year} +0000"

def format_commit(commit, fmt_str, head_info):
    dec=build_decoration(commit, head_info)
    ex={
        "%H": commit["hash"],
        "%h": commit["hash"][:7],
        "%P": " ".join(commit["parents"]),
        "%p": " ".join([p[:7] for p in commit["parents"]]),
        "%d": dec,
        "%s": commit["s"],
        "%b": commit["b"],
        "%B": commit["B"],
        "%an": commit["an"],
        "%ae": commit["ae"],
        "%ad": format_date(commit["at"]),
        "%as": commit["as"],
        "%cn": commit["cn"],
        "%ce": commit["ce"],
        "%cd": format_date(commit["ct"]),
        "%cs": commit["cs"],
        "%n": "\n",
    }
    res=[]
    j=0
    while j < len(fmt_str):
        if fmt_str[j]=='%':
            if j+1 < len(fmt_str) and fmt_str[j+1] in ('+','-',' '):
                mod=fmt_str[j+1]
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+3 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+2:j+4]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+2]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        found="%%"
                        ph_len=1
                if found:
                    exp=ex.get(found, found)
                    if mod=='+':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append("\n")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod==' ':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append(" ")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod=='-':
                        if exp=="":
                            combined="".join(res)
                            combined=combined.rstrip("\n")
                            res=[combined]
                        else:
                            res.append(exp)
                    j+=2+ph_len
                    continue
                else:
                    if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                        res.append(fmt_str[j:j+3])
                        j+=3
                        continue
            else:
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+1:j+3]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+1 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+1]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        res.append("%%")
                        j+=2
                        continue
                    else:
                        res.append("%"+one)
                        j+=2
                        continue
                if found:
                    res.append(ex.get(found, found))
                    j+=1+ph_len
                    continue
        res.append(fmt_str[j])
        j+=1
    return "".join(res)

def main():
    argv=sys.argv[1:]

                iv=int(val)
                if iv<=0:

            def is_int(s):

            if tokens:

        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)<3: continue
        obj,refname,short=parts[0],parts[1],parts[2]
        if refname.startswith("refs/heads/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/heads/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":False,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/remotes/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/remotes/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":True,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/tags/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/tags/"):]
            internal=f"tags/{name}"
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":internal,"short":short,"kind":"tag","is_remote":False,"is_tag":True,"tag_name":name})
    return refs

def get_commits(repo,max_count=None,reverse=False):
    cmd=["log","--all","--date-order","--pretty=format:%H%x00%P%x00%an%x00%ae%x00%at%x00%as%x00%cn%x00%ce%x00%ct%x00%cs%x00%s%x00%b%x00%B%x1f","--date=unix"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    commits=[]
    for rec in out.split("\x1f"):
        if not rec.strip(): continue
        rec=rec.lstrip("\n")
        fields=rec.split("\x00")
        if len(fields)<13: continue
        H=fields[0].strip()
        P=fields[1].strip()
        parents=P.split() if P else []
        commits.append({"hash":H,"parents":parents,"an":fields[2],"ae":fields[3],"at":fields[4],"as":fields[5],"cn":fields[6],"ce":fields[7],"ct":fields[8],"cs":fields[9],"s":fields[10],"b":fields[11],"B":fields[12],"refs":[],"branch":None})
    if reverse:
        commits=list(reversed(commits))
    if max_count is not None:
        commits=commits[:max_count]
    return commits

def assign_refs(commits,refs):
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    for r in refs:
        if r["hash"] in hm:
            commits[hm[r["hash"]]]["refs"].append(r)

def parse_model_file(name):
    d=get_models_dir()
    builtin={
        "git-flow":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(develop|dev)$","^feature.*$","^release.*$","^hotfix.*$","^bugfix.*$"],"order":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(hotfix|release).*$","^(develop|dev)$"]},
        "simple":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$"],"order":["^tags/.*$","^(master|main|trunk)$"]},
        "none":{"persistence":[],"order":[]},
    }
    fp=d / f"{name}.toml"
    if fp.is_file():
        try:
            txt=fp.read_text()
            def extract(key):
                pat=re.compile(rf'{re.escape(key)}\s*=\s*\[')
                m=pat.search(txt)
                if not m: return None
                start=m.end()-1
                depth=0
                end=-1
                for i in range(start,len(txt)):
                    if txt[i]=='[': depth+=1
                    elif txt[i]==']':
                        depth-=1
                        if depth==0:
                            end=i
                            break
                if end==-1: return None
                return txt[start:end+1]
            def parse_str_arr(s):
                return re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', s) if s else []
            pers=parse_str_arr(extract("persistence"))
            order=parse_str_arr(extract("order"))
            return {"persistence":pers,"order":order}
        except:
            return None
    if name in builtin:
        return builtin[name]
    return None

def persistence_of(branch_name,model):
    pers=model.get("persistence",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(pers):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
            if "/" in branch_name:
                last=branch_name.split("/")[-1]
                if re.search(pat, last):
                    return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(pers)

def order_of(branch_name,model):
    order=model.get("order",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(order):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(order)

def assign_branches(commits,refs,model):
    branches=[]
    for r in refs:
        branches.append({"name":r["name"],"hash":r["hash"],"is_tag":r["is_tag"],"is_remote":r["is_remote"],"is_unknown":False})
    pers_list=[]
    for idx,br in enumerate(branches):
        pers_list.append((persistence_of(br["name"], model), idx))
    pers_list.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    assigned={}
    ranges={}
    for _,b_idx in pers_list:
        br=branches[b_idx]
        if br["hash"] not in hm:
            continue
        cur=hm[br["hash"]]
        first=True
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            h=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if h in assigned:
                if not first:
                    break
                else:
                    if assigned[h]!=b_idx:
                        start=None
                        break
            else:
                assigned[h]=b_idx
                commits[cur]["branch"]=br["name"]
                if first:
                    start=cur
                    end=cur
                    first=False
                else:
                    if cur<start: start=cur
                    if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        if start is not None:
            ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    unassigned=[c["hash"] for c in commits if c["hash"] not in assigned]
    unassigned_sorted=sorted(unassigned, key=lambda h: hm[h])
    for h in unassigned_sorted:
        if h in assigned:
            continue
        branches.append({"name":"unknown","hash":h,"is_tag":False,"is_remote":False,"is_unknown":True})
        b_idx=len(branches)-1
        cur=hm[h]
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            ch=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if ch in assigned:
                break
            assigned[ch]=b_idx
            commits[cur]["branch"]="unknown"
            if cur<start: start=cur
            if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    for i,c in enumerate(commits):
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for ph in c["parents"][1:]:
                if ph in assigned:
                    pb_idx=assigned[ph]
                    if pb_idx in ranges:
                        s,e=ranges[pb_idx]
                        ns=min(s,i)
                        ne=max(e,i)
                        ranges[pb_idx]=(ns,ne)
    return branches, assigned, ranges

def build_decoration(commit, head_info):
    branch_refs=[]
    tag_refs=[]
    for r in commit["refs"]:
        if r.get("is_tag"):
            tag_refs.append(r.get("tag_name") or r["short"])
        else:
            branch_refs.append(r)
    branch_names=[r["name"] for r in branch_refs]
    is_head = (commit["hash"] == head_info.get("head_hash"))
    head_branch = head_info.get("head_branch")
    if is_head:
        if head_branch:
            if head_branch in branch_names:
                new=[]
                for b in branch_names:
                    if b==head_branch:
                        new.append(f"HEAD -> {b}")
                    else:
                        new.append(b)
                branch_names=new
            else:
                branch_names=[f"HEAD -> {head_branch}"]+branch_names
        else:
            branch_names=["HEAD"]+branch_names
    dec=""
    if branch_names:
        dec+=" ("+", ".join(branch_names)+")"
    if tag_refs:
        dec+=" ["+", ".join(tag_refs)+"]"
    return dec

def format_date(unix_str):
    try:
        ts=int(unix_str)
    except:
        return unix_str
    import datetime
    dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
    day=dt.day
    day_str=f"{day:2d}"
    prefix=dt.strftime("%a %b")
    time_part=dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    year=dt.strftime("%Y")
    return f"{prefix}{day_str} {time_part} {year} +0000"

def format_commit(commit, fmt_str, head_info):
    dec=build_decoration(commit, head_info)
    ex={
        "%H": commit["hash"],
        "%h": commit["hash"][:7],
        "%P": " ".join(commit["parents"]),
        "%p": " ".join([p[:7] for p in commit["parents"]]),
        "%d": dec,
        "%s": commit["s"],
        "%b": commit["b"],
        "%B": commit["B"],
        "%an": commit["an"],
        "%ae": commit["ae"],
        "%ad": format_date(commit["at"]),
        "%as": commit["as"],
        "%cn": commit["cn"],
        "%ce": commit["ce"],
        "%cd": format_date(commit["ct"]),
        "%cs": commit["cs"],
        "%n": "\n",
    }
    res=[]
    j=0
    while j < len(fmt_str):
        if fmt_str[j]=='%':
            if j+1 < len(fmt_str) and fmt_str[j+1] in ('+','-',' '):
                mod=fmt_str[j+1]
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+3 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+2:j+4]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+2]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        found="%%"
                        ph_len=1
                if found:
                    exp=ex.get(found, found)
                    if mod=='+':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append("\n")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod==' ':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append(" ")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod=='-':
                        if exp=="":
                            combined="".join(res)
                            combined=combined.rstrip("\n")
                            res=[combined]
                        else:
                            res.append(exp)
                    j+=2+ph_len
                    continue
                else:
                    if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                        res.append(fmt_str[j:j+3])
                        j+=3
                        continue
            else:
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+1:j+3]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+1 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+1]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        res.append("%%")
                        j+=2
                        continue
                    else:
                        res.append("%"+one)
                        j+=2
                        continue
                if found:
                    res.append(ex.get(found, found))
                    j+=1+ph_len
                    continue
        res.append(fmt_str[j])
        j+=1
    return "".join(res)

    return pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"git-graph"/"models"

def list_models():

    models=[]
    if d.is_dir():
        try:

        except:
            entries=[]
        for e in entries:

def find_repo(start):
    p=pathlib.Path(start)
    if not p.exists():
        return None,f"failed to resolve path '{start}'"
    if p.is_file():
        p=p.parent
    p=p.resolve()
    for parent in [p]+list(p.parents):
        if (parent/".git").exists():
            return parent,None
    return None,f"could not find repository at '{start}'"

def get_repo_model(repo):
    cfg=pathlib.Path(repo)/".git"/"git-graph.toml"
    if cfg.is_file():
        try:
            txt=cfg.read_text()
            m=re.search(r'model\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']',txt)
            if m:
                return m.group(1)
        except:
            pass
    return None

    r=subprocess.run(["git"]+list(args),cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)

def get_refs(repo,local=False):
    fmt="%(objectname) %(refname) %(refname:short)"
    cmd=["for-each-ref","--format",fmt]
    if local:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/tags"]
    else:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/remotes","refs/tags"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    refs=[]
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if not line.strip(): continue
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)<3: continue
        obj,refname,short=parts[0],parts[1],parts[2]
        if refname.startswith("refs/heads/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/heads/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":False,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/remotes/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/remotes/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":True,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/tags/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/tags/"):]
            internal=f"tags/{name}"
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":internal,"short":short,"kind":"tag","is_remote":False,"is_tag":True,"tag_name":name})
    return refs

    commits=[]

        if not rec.strip(): continue
        rec=rec.lstrip("\n")
        fields=rec.split("\x00")
        if len(fields)<13: continue
        H=fields[0].strip()
        P=fields[1].strip()
        parents=P.split() if P else []
        commits.append({"hash":H,"parents":parents,"an":fields[2],"ae":fields[3],"at":fields[4],"as":fields[5],"cn":fields[6],"ce":fields[7],"ct":fields[8],"cs":fields[9],"s":fields[10],"b":fields[11],"B":fields[12],"refs":[],"branch":None})
    if reverse:
        commits=list(reversed(commits))
    if max_count is not None:
        commits=commits[:max_count]
    return commits

def assign_refs(commits,refs):
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    for r in refs:
        if r["hash"] in hm:
            commits[hm[r["hash"]]]["refs"].append(r)

def parse_model_file(name):
    d=get_models_dir()
    builtin={
        "git-flow":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(develop|dev)$","^feature.*$","^release.*$","^hotfix.*$","^bugfix.*$"],"order":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(hotfix|release).*$","^(develop|dev)$"]},
        "simple":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$"],"order":["^tags/.*$","^(master|main|trunk)$"]},
        "none":{"persistence":[],"order":[]},
    }
    fp=d / f"{name}.toml"
    if fp.is_file():
        try:
            txt=fp.read_text()
            def extract(key):
                pat=re.compile(rf'{re.escape(key)}\s*=\s*\[')
                m=pat.search(txt)
                if not m: return None
                start=m.end()-1
                depth=0
                end=-1
                for i in range(start,len(txt)):
                    if txt[i]=='[': depth+=1
                    elif txt[i]==']':
                        depth-=1
                        if depth==0:
                            end=i
                            break
                if end==-1: return None
                return txt[start:end+1]
            def parse_str_arr(s):
                return re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', s) if s else []
            pers=parse_str_arr(extract("persistence"))
            order=parse_str_arr(extract("order"))
            return {"persistence":pers,"order":order}
        except:
            return None
    if name in builtin:
        return builtin[name]
    return None

def persistence_of(branch_name,model):
    pers=model.get("persistence",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(pers):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
            if "/" in branch_name:
                last=branch_name.split("/")[-1]
                if re.search(pat, last):
                    return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(pers)

def order_of(branch_name,model):
    order=model.get("order",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(order):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(order)

def assign_branches(commits,refs,model):
    branches=[]
    for r in refs:
        branches.append({"name":r["name"],"hash":r["hash"],"is_tag":r["is_tag"],"is_remote":r["is_remote"],"is_unknown":False})
    pers_list=[]
    for idx,br in enumerate(branches):
        pers_list.append((persistence_of(br["name"], model), idx))
    pers_list.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    assigned={}
    ranges={}
    for _,b_idx in pers_list:
        br=branches[b_idx]
        if br["hash"] not in hm:
            continue
        cur=hm[br["hash"]]
        first=True
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            h=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if h in assigned:
                if not first:
                    break
                else:
                    if assigned[h]!=b_idx:
                        start=None
                        break
            else:
                assigned[h]=b_idx
                commits[cur]["branch"]=br["name"]
                if first:
                    start=cur
                    end=cur
                    first=False
                else:
                    if cur<start: start=cur
                    if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        if start is not None:
            ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    unassigned=[c["hash"] for c in commits if c["hash"] not in assigned]
    unassigned_sorted=sorted(unassigned, key=lambda h: hm[h])
    for h in unassigned_sorted:
        if h in assigned:
            continue
        branches.append({"name":"unknown","hash":h,"is_tag":False,"is_remote":False,"is_unknown":True})
        b_idx=len(branches)-1
        cur=hm[h]
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            ch=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if ch in assigned:
                break
            assigned[ch]=b_idx
            commits[cur]["branch"]="unknown"
            if cur<start: start=cur
            if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    for i,c in enumerate(commits):
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for ph in c["parents"][1:]:
                if ph in assigned:
                    pb_idx=assigned[ph]
                    if pb_idx in ranges:
                        s,e=ranges[pb_idx]
                        ns=min(s,i)
                        ne=max(e,i)
                        ranges[pb_idx]=(ns,ne)
    return branches, assigned, ranges

def build_decoration(commit, head_info):
    branch_refs=[]
    tag_refs=[]
    for r in commit["refs"]:
        if r.get("is_tag"):
            tag_refs.append(r.get("tag_name") or r["short"])
        else:
            branch_refs.append(r)
    branch_names=[r["name"] for r in branch_refs]
    is_head = (commit["hash"] == head_info.get("head_hash"))
    head_branch = head_info.get("head_branch")
    if is_head:
        if head_branch:
            if head_branch in branch_names:
                new=[]
                for b in branch_names:
                    if b==head_branch:
                        new.append(f"HEAD -> {b}")
                    else:
                        new.append(b)
                branch_names=new
            else:
                branch_names=[f"HEAD -> {head_branch}"]+branch_names
        else:
            branch_names=["HEAD"]+branch_names
    dec=""
    if branch_names:
        dec+=" ("+", ".join(branch_names)+")"
    if tag_refs:
        dec+=" ["+", ".join(tag_refs)+"]"
    return dec

def format_date(unix_str):
    try:
        ts=int(unix_str)
    except:
        return unix_str
    import datetime
    dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
    day=dt.day
    day_str=f"{day:2d}"
    prefix=dt.strftime("%a %b")
    time_part=dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    year=dt.strftime("%Y")
    return f"{prefix}{day_str} {time_part} {year} +0000"

def format_commit(commit, fmt_str, head_info):
    dec=build_decoration(commit, head_info)
    ex={
        "%H": commit["hash"],
        "%h": commit["hash"][:7],
        "%P": " ".join(commit["parents"]),
        "%p": " ".join([p[:7] for p in commit["parents"]]),
        "%d": dec,
        "%s": commit["s"],
        "%b": commit["b"],
        "%B": commit["B"],
        "%an": commit["an"],
        "%ae": commit["ae"],
        "%ad": format_date(commit["at"]),
        "%as": commit["as"],
        "%cn": commit["cn"],
        "%ce": commit["ce"],
        "%cd": format_date(commit["ct"]),
        "%cs": commit["cs"],
        "%n": "\n",
    }
    res=[]
    j=0
    while j < len(fmt_str):
        if fmt_str[j]=='%':
            if j+1 < len(fmt_str) and fmt_str[j+1] in ('+','-',' '):
                mod=fmt_str[j+1]
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+3 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+2:j+4]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+2]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        found="%%"
                        ph_len=1
                if found:
                    exp=ex.get(found, found)
                    if mod=='+':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append("\n")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod==' ':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append(" ")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod=='-':
                        if exp=="":
                            combined="".join(res)
                            combined=combined.rstrip("\n")
                            res=[combined]
                        else:
                            res.append(exp)
                    j+=2+ph_len
                    continue
                else:
                    if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                        res.append(fmt_str[j:j+3])
                        j+=3
                        continue
            else:
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+1:j+3]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+1 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+1]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        res.append("%%")
                        j+=2
                        continue
                    else:
                        res.append("%"+one)
                        j+=2
                        continue
                if found:
                    res.append(ex.get(found, found))
                    j+=1+ph_len
                    continue
        res.append(fmt_str[j])
        j+=1
    return "".join(res)

    return pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"git-graph"/"models"

        try:

def find_repo(start):
    p=pathlib.Path(start)
    if not p.exists():
        return None,f"failed to resolve path '{start}'"
    if p.is_file():
        p=p.parent
    p=p.resolve()
    for parent in [p]+list(p.parents):
        if (parent/".git").exists():
            return parent,None
    return None,f"could not find repository at '{start}'"

def get_repo_model(repo):
    cfg=pathlib.Path(repo)/".git"/"git-graph.toml"
    if cfg.is_file():
        try:
            txt=cfg.read_text()
            m=re.search(r'model\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']',txt)
            if m:
                return m.group(1)
        except:
            pass
    return None

def run_git(repo,*args):
    r=subprocess.run(["git"]+list(args),cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
    return r.stdout,r.stderr,r.returncode

def get_refs(repo,local=False):
    fmt="%(objectname) %(refname) %(refname:short)"
    cmd=["for-each-ref","--format",fmt]
    if local:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/tags"]
    else:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/remotes","refs/tags"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    refs=[]
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if not line.strip(): continue
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)<3: continue
        obj,refname,short=parts[0],parts[1],parts[2]
        if refname.startswith("refs/heads/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/heads/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":False,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/remotes/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/remotes/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":True,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/tags/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/tags/"):]
            internal=f"tags/{name}"
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":internal,"short":short,"kind":"tag","is_remote":False,"is_tag":True,"tag_name":name})
    return refs

def get_commits(repo,max_count=None,reverse=False):
    cmd=["log","--all","--date-order","--pretty=format:%H%x00%P%x00%an%x00%ae%x00%at%x00%as%x00%cn%x00%ce%x00%ct%x00%cs%x00%s%x00%b%x00%B%x1f","--date=unix"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    commits=[]
    for rec in out.split("\x1f"):
        if not rec.strip(): continue
        rec=rec.lstrip("\n")
        fields=rec.split("\x00")
        if len(fields)<13: continue
        H=fields[0].strip()
        P=fields[1].strip()
        parents=P.split() if P else []
        commits.append({"hash":H,"parents":parents,"an":fields[2],"ae":fields[3],"at":fields[4],"as":fields[5],"cn":fields[6],"ce":fields[7],"ct":fields[8],"cs":fields[9],"s":fields[10],"b":fields[11],"B":fields[12],"refs":[],"branch":None})
    if reverse:
        commits=list(reversed(commits))
    if max_count is not None:
        commits=commits[:max_count]
    return commits

    if fp.is_file():
        try:
            txt=fp.read_text()
            def extract(key):
                pat=re.compile(rf'{re.escape(key)}\s*=\s*\[')
                m=pat.search(txt)
                if not m: return None
                start=m.end()-1
                depth=0
                end=-1
                for i in range(start,len(txt)):
                    if txt[i]=='[': depth+=1
                    elif txt[i]==']':
                        depth-=1
                        if depth==0:
                            end=i
                            break
                if end==-1: return None
                return txt[start:end+1]
            def parse_str_arr(s):
                return re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', s) if s else []
            pers=parse_str_arr(extract("persistence"))
            order=parse_str_arr(extract("order"))
            return {"persistence":pers,"order":order}
        except:
            return None
    if name in builtin:
        return builtin[name]
    return None

def persistence_of(branch_name,model):
    pers=model.get("persistence",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(pers):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
            if "/" in branch_name:
                last=branch_name.split("/")[-1]
                if re.search(pat, last):
                    return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(pers)

def order_of(branch_name,model):
    order=model.get("order",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(order):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(order)

def assign_branches(commits,refs,model):
    branches=[]
    for r in refs:
        branches.append({"name":r["name"],"hash":r["hash"],"is_tag":r["is_tag"],"is_remote":r["is_remote"],"is_unknown":False})
    pers_list=[]
    for idx,br in enumerate(branches):
        pers_list.append((persistence_of(br["name"], model), idx))
    pers_list.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    assigned={}
    ranges={}
    for _,b_idx in pers_list:
        br=branches[b_idx]
        if br["hash"] not in hm:
            continue
        cur=hm[br["hash"]]
        first=True
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            h=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if h in assigned:
                if not first:
                    break
                else:
                    if assigned[h]!=b_idx:
                        start=None
                        break
            else:
                assigned[h]=b_idx
                commits[cur]["branch"]=br["name"]
                if first:
                    start=cur
                    end=cur
                    first=False
                else:
                    if cur<start: start=cur
                    if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        if start is not None:
            ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    unassigned=[c["hash"] for c in commits if c["hash"] not in assigned]
    unassigned_sorted=sorted(unassigned, key=lambda h: hm[h])
    for h in unassigned_sorted:
        if h in assigned:
            continue
        branches.append({"name":"unknown","hash":h,"is_tag":False,"is_remote":False,"is_unknown":True})
        b_idx=len(branches)-1
        cur=hm[h]
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            ch=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if ch in assigned:
                break
            assigned[ch]=b_idx
            commits[cur]["branch"]="unknown"
            if cur<start: start=cur
            if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    for i,c in enumerate(commits):
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for ph in c["parents"][1:]:
                if ph in assigned:
                    pb_idx=assigned[ph]
                    if pb_idx in ranges:
                        s,e=ranges[pb_idx]
                        ns=min(s,i)
                        ne=max(e,i)
                        ranges[pb_idx]=(ns,ne)
    return branches, assigned, ranges

def build_decoration(commit, head_info):
    branch_refs=[]
    tag_refs=[]
    for r in commit["refs"]:
        if r.get("is_tag"):
            tag_refs.append(r.get("tag_name") or r["short"])
        else:
            branch_refs.append(r)
    branch_names=[r["name"] for r in branch_refs]
    is_head = (commit["hash"] == head_info.get("head_hash"))
    head_branch = head_info.get("head_branch")
    if is_head:
        if head_branch:
            if head_branch in branch_names:
                new=[]
                for b in branch_names:
                    if b==head_branch:
                        new.append(f"HEAD -> {b}")
                    else:
                        new.append(b)
                branch_names=new
            else:
                branch_names=[f"HEAD -> {head_branch}"]+branch_names
        else:
            branch_names=["HEAD"]+branch_names
    dec=""
    if branch_names:
        dec+=" ("+", ".join(branch_names)+")"
    if tag_refs:
        dec+=" ["+", ".join(tag_refs)+"]"
    return dec

def format_date(unix_str):
    try:
        ts=int(unix_str)
    except:
        return unix_str
    import datetime
    dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
    day=dt.day
    day_str=f"{day:2d}"
    prefix=dt.strftime("%a %b")
    time_part=dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    year=dt.strftime("%Y")
    return f"{prefix}{day_str} {time_part} {year} +0000"

def format_commit(commit, fmt_str, head_info):
    dec=build_decoration(commit, head_info)
    ex={
        "%H": commit["hash"],
        "%h": commit["hash"][:7],
        "%P": " ".join(commit["parents"]),
        "%p": " ".join([p[:7] for p in commit["parents"]]),
        "%d": dec,
        "%s": commit["s"],
        "%b": commit["b"],
        "%B": commit["B"],
        "%an": commit["an"],
        "%ae": commit["ae"],
        "%ad": format_date(commit["at"]),
        "%as": commit["as"],
        "%cn": commit["cn"],
        "%ce": commit["ce"],
        "%cd": format_date(commit["ct"]),
        "%cs": commit["cs"],
        "%n": "\n",
    }
    res=[]
    j=0
    while j < len(fmt_str):
        if fmt_str[j]=='%':
            if j+1 < len(fmt_str) and fmt_str[j+1] in ('+','-',' '):
                mod=fmt_str[j+1]
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+3 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+2:j+4]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+2]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        found="%%"
                        ph_len=1
                if found:
                    exp=ex.get(found, found)
                    if mod=='+':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append("\n")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod==' ':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append(" ")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod=='-':
                        if exp=="":
                            combined="".join(res)
                            combined=combined.rstrip("\n")
                            res=[combined]
                        else:
                            res.append(exp)
                    j+=2+ph_len
                    continue
                else:
                    if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                        res.append(fmt_str[j:j+3])
                        j+=3
                        continue
            else:
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+1:j+3]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+1 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+1]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        res.append("%%")
                        j+=2
                        continue
                    else:
                        res.append("%"+one)
                        j+=2
                        continue
                if found:
                    res.append(ex.get(found, found))
                    j+=1+ph_len
                    continue
        res.append(fmt_str[j])
        j+=1
    return "".join(res)

def find_repo(start):
    p=pathlib.Path(start)
    if not p.exists():
        return None,f"failed to resolve path '{start}'"
    if p.is_file():
        p=p.parent
    p=p.resolve()
    for parent in [p]+list(p.parents):
        if (parent/".git").exists():
            return parent,None
    return None,f"could not find repository at '{start}'"

            m=re.search(r'model\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']',txt)

def get_refs(repo,local=False):
    fmt="%(objectname) %(refname) %(refname:short)"
    cmd=["for-each-ref","--format",fmt]
    if local:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/tags"]
    else:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/remotes","refs/tags"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    refs=[]
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if not line.strip(): continue
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)<3: continue
        obj,refname,short=parts[0],parts[1],parts[2]
        if refname.startswith("refs/heads/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/heads/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":False,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/remotes/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/remotes/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":True,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/tags/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/tags/"):]
            internal=f"tags/{name}"
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":internal,"short":short,"kind":"tag","is_remote":False,"is_tag":True,"tag_name":name})
    return refs

    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    commits=[]
    for rec in out.split("\x1f"):
        if not rec.strip(): continue
        rec=rec.lstrip("\n")
        fields=rec.split("\x00")
        if len(fields)<13: continue
        H=fields[0].strip()
        P=fields[1].strip()
        parents=P.split() if P else []
        commits.append({"hash":H,"parents":parents,"an":fields[2],"ae":fields[3],"at":fields[4],"as":fields[5],"cn":fields[6],"ce":fields[7],"ct":fields[8],"cs":fields[9],"s":fields[10],"b":fields[11],"B":fields[12],"refs":[],"branch":None})
    if reverse:
        commits=list(reversed(commits))
    if max_count is not None:
        commits=commits[:max_count]
    return commits

def parse_model_file(name):
    d=get_models_dir()
    builtin={
        "git-flow":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(develop|dev)$","^feature.*$","^release.*$","^hotfix.*$","^bugfix.*$"],"order":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(hotfix|release).*$","^(develop|dev)$"]},
        "simple":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$"],"order":["^tags/.*$","^(master|main|trunk)$"]},
        "none":{"persistence":[],"order":[]},
    }
    fp=d / f"{name}.toml"
    if fp.is_file():
        try:
            txt=fp.read_text()
            def extract(key):
                pat=re.compile(rf'{re.escape(key)}\s*=\s*\[')
                m=pat.search(txt)
                if not m: return None
                start=m.end()-1
                depth=0
                end=-1
                for i in range(start,len(txt)):
                    if txt[i]=='[': depth+=1
                    elif txt[i]==']':
                        depth-=1
                        if depth==0:
                            end=i
                            break
                if end==-1: return None
                return txt[start:end+1]
            def parse_str_arr(s):
                return re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', s) if s else []
            pers=parse_str_arr(extract("persistence"))
            order=parse_str_arr(extract("order"))
            return {"persistence":pers,"order":order}
        except:
            return None
    if name in builtin:
        return builtin[name]
    return None

def persistence_of(branch_name,model):
    pers=model.get("persistence",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(pers):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
            if "/" in branch_name:
                last=branch_name.split("/")[-1]
                if re.search(pat, last):
                    return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(pers)

def order_of(branch_name,model):
    order=model.get("order",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(order):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i

    return len(order)

    branches=[]
    for r in refs:
        branches.append({"name":r["name"],"hash":r["hash"],"is_tag":r["is_tag"],"is_remote":r["is_remote"],"is_unknown":False})
    pers_list=[]
    for idx,br in enumerate(branches):
        pers_list.append((persistence_of(br["name"], model), idx))
    pers_list.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    assigned={}
    ranges={}
    for _,b_idx in pers_list:
        br=branches[b_idx]
        if br["hash"] not in hm:
            continue
        cur=hm[br["hash"]]
        first=True
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            h=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if h in assigned:
                if not first:
                    break
                else:
                    if assigned[h]!=b_idx:
                        start=None
                        break
            else:
                assigned[h]=b_idx
                commits[cur]["branch"]=br["name"]
                if first:
                    start=cur
                    end=cur
                    first=False
                else:
                    if cur<start: start=cur
                    if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        if start is not None:
            ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    unassigned=[c["hash"] for c in commits if c["hash"] not in assigned]
    unassigned_sorted=sorted(unassigned, key=lambda h: hm[h])
    for h in unassigned_sorted:
        if h in assigned:
            continue
        branches.append({"name":"unknown","hash":h,"is_tag":False,"is_remote":False,"is_unknown":True})
        b_idx=len(branches)-1
        cur=hm[h]
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            ch=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if ch in assigned:
                break
            assigned[ch]=b_idx
            commits[cur]["branch"]="unknown"
            if cur<start: start=cur
            if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    for i,c in enumerate(commits):
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for ph in c["parents"][1:]:
                if ph in assigned:
                    pb_idx=assigned[ph]
                    if pb_idx in ranges:
                        s,e=ranges[pb_idx]
                        ns=min(s,i)
                        ne=max(e,i)
                        ranges[pb_idx]=(ns,ne)
    return branches, assigned, ranges

def build_decoration(commit, head_info):
    branch_refs=[]
    tag_refs=[]
    for r in commit["refs"]:
        if r.get("is_tag"):
            tag_refs.append(r.get("tag_name") or r["short"])
        else:
            branch_refs.append(r)
    branch_names=[r["name"] for r in branch_refs]
    is_head = (commit["hash"] == head_info.get("head_hash"))
    head_branch = head_info.get("head_branch")
    if is_head:
        if head_branch:
            if head_branch in branch_names:
                new=[]
                for b in branch_names:
                    if b==head_branch:
                        new.append(f"HEAD -> {b}")
                    else:
                        new.append(b)
                branch_names=new
            else:
                branch_names=[f"HEAD -> {head_branch}"]+branch_names
        else:
            branch_names=["HEAD"]+branch_names
    dec=""
    if branch_names:
        dec+=" ("+", ".join(branch_names)+")"
    if tag_refs:
        dec+=" ["+", ".join(tag_refs)+"]"
    return dec

def format_date(unix_str):
    try:
        ts=int(unix_str)
    except:
        return unix_str
    import datetime
    dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
    day=dt.day
    day_str=f"{day:2d}"
    prefix=dt.strftime("%a %b")
    time_part=dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    year=dt.strftime("%Y")
    return f"{prefix}{day_str} {time_part} {year} +0000"

def format_commit(commit, fmt_str, head_info):
    dec=build_decoration(commit, head_info)
    ex={
        "%H": commit["hash"],
        "%h": commit["hash"][:7],
        "%P": " ".join(commit["parents"]),
        "%p": " ".join([p[:7] for p in commit["parents"]]),
        "%d": dec,
        "%s": commit["s"],
        "%b": commit["b"],
        "%B": commit["B"],
        "%an": commit["an"],
        "%ae": commit["ae"],
        "%ad": format_date(commit["at"]),
        "%as": commit["as"],
        "%cn": commit["cn"],
        "%ce": commit["ce"],
        "%cd": format_date(commit["ct"]),
        "%cs": commit["cs"],
        "%n": "\n",
    }
    res=[]
    j=0
    while j < len(fmt_str):
        if fmt_str[j]=='%':
            if j+1 < len(fmt_str) and fmt_str[j+1] in ('+','-',' '):
                mod=fmt_str[j+1]
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+3 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+2:j+4]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+2]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        found="%%"
                        ph_len=1
                if found:
                    exp=ex.get(found, found)
                    if mod=='+':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append("\n")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod==' ':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append(" ")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod=='-':
                        if exp=="":
                            combined="".join(res)
                            combined=combined.rstrip("\n")
                            res=[combined]
                        else:
                            res.append(exp)
                    j+=2+ph_len
                    continue
                else:
                    if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                        res.append(fmt_str[j:j+3])
                        j+=3
                        continue
            else:
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+1:j+3]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+1 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+1]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        res.append("%%")
                        j+=2
                        continue
                    else:
                        res.append("%"+one)
                        j+=2
                        continue
                if found:
                    res.append(ex.get(found, found))
                    j+=1+ph_len
                    continue
        res.append(fmt_str[j])
        j+=1
    return "".join(res)
