                print(f"{br['name']} (col {col}) {rng}  s: {s_str}, t: {t_str}")

    if global_opts["svg"]:
        cols=[c for c in col_assign.values() if c!=99]
        max_col = max(cols) if cols else 0
        num_cols = max_col+1
        rows=len(commits)
        width=(num_cols+1)*15
        height=rows*15+15
        print(f'<svg height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" width="{width}" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">')
        for b_idx,(s,e) in ranges.items():
            if col_assign.get(b_idx,99)==99:
                continue
            col=col_assign[b_idx]
            x=col*15+15
            y1=s*15+15
            y2=e*15+15
            if s!=e:
                print(f'<line stroke="blue" stroke-width="1" x1="{x}" x2="{x}" y1="{y1}" y2="{y2}"/>')
        for i,c in enumerate(commits):
            if len(c["parents"])>1:
                cur_col=col_assign.get(assigned.get(c["hash"],0),0)
                cur_x=cur_col*15+15
                cur_y=i*15+15
                for ph in c["parents"][1:]:
                    p_idx=None
                    for j,c2 in enumerate(commits):
                        if c2["hash"]==ph:
                            p_idx=j
                            break
                    if p_idx is None:
                        continue
                    parent_col=col_assign.get(assigned.get(ph,0),0)
                    parent_x=parent_col*15+15
                    parent_y=p_idx*15+15
                    print(f'<path d="M{cur_x},{cur_y} L{cur_x},{parent_y} Q{cur_x},{(cur_y+parent_y)//2},{parent_x},{(cur_y+parent_y)//2} Q{parent_x},{(cur_y+parent_y)//2},{parent_x},{parent_y}" fill="none" stroke="purple" stroke-width="1"/>')
        for i,c in enumerate(commits):
            b_idx=assigned.get(c["hash"])
            col=col_assign.get(b_idx,0) if b_idx is not None else 0
            x=col*15+15
            y=i*15+15
            fill="white" if len(c["parents"])>1 else "blue"
            print(f'<circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" fill="{fill}" r="4" stroke="blue" stroke-width="1"/>')
        print('</svg>')
        if global_opts["debug"]:
            print(f"Graph construction: 0.0 ms, printing: 0.0 ms ({len(commits)} commits)")
        sys.exit(0)

    if global_opts["skip_owner_validation"]:
        print("Warning: skip-repo-owner-validation is set! ")

    name_to_col={}
    for b_idx,br in enumerate(branches):
        name_to_col[br["name"]]=col_assign.get(b_idx,0)

    def active_at(idx):
        cols=[]
        for b_idx,(s,e) in ranges.items():
            if s <= idx <= e:
                cols.append(col_assign.get(b_idx,0))
        return sorted(set(cols))

    style=global_opts["style"]
    if style=="ascii":
        commit_char="*"
        merge_char="o"
        vertical="|"
        horizontal="-"
    else:
        commit_char="\u25cf"
        merge_char="\u25cb"
        vertical="\u2502" if style in ("normal","thin","round") else ("\u2503" if style=="bold" else "\u2551")
        horizontal="\u2500" if style in ("normal","thin","round") else ("\u2501" if style=="bold" else "\u2550")

    lines_out=[]
    i=0
    all_cols=[c for c in col_assign.values() if c!=99]
    total_graph_cols = max(all_cols)+1 if all_cols else 1
    while i < len(commits):
        c=commits[i]
        cur_branch=c.get("branch")
        cur_col=name_to_col.get(cur_branch,0)
        active=active_at(i)
        max_needed = cur_col
        if active:
            max_needed = max(max_needed, max(active))
        parent_cols=[]
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for ph in c["parents"][1:]:
                for j,c2 in enumerate(commits):
                    if c2["hash"]==ph:
                        pb=c2.get("branch")
                        pc=name_to_col.get(pb)
                        if pc is not None:
                            parent_cols.append(pc)
                            max_needed = max(max_needed, pc)
                        break
        max_needed = max(max_needed, total_graph_cols-1)
        blocks=[]
        for col in range(max_needed+1):
            if col==cur_col:
                ch=merge_char if len(c["parents"])>1 else commit_char
                if col==0:
                    blocks.append(f" {ch} ")
                else:
                    blocks.append(f"{ch}  ")
            else:
                if col in active:
                    if col > cur_col:
                        blocks.append(f"{vertical}  ")
                    else:
                        blocks.append(f" {vertical} ")
                else:
                    blocks.append("   ")
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for ph, parent_col in zip(c["parents"][1:], parent_cols):
                if parent_col is None:
                    continue
                if parent_col > cur_col:
                    b0=list(blocks[cur_col])
                    if len(b0)>=3:
                        b0[2]='<'
                    blocks[cur_col]="".join(b0)
                    for cc in range(cur_col+1, parent_col):
                        if cc < len(blocks):
                            blocks[cc]="---" if style=="ascii" else horizontal*3
                    if parent_col < len(blocks):
                        blocks[parent_col]=".  " if style=="ascii" else (("\u2510  " if style in ("normal","thin") else ("\u256e  " if style=="round" else ("\u2513  " if style=="bold" else "\u2557  "))))
                elif parent_col < cur_col:
                    b0=list(blocks[cur_col])
                    if len(b0)>=3:
                        b0[0]='>'
                    blocks[cur_col]="".join(b0)
                    for cc in range(parent_col+1, cur_col):
                        if cc < len(blocks):
                            blocks[cc]="---" if style=="ascii" else horizontal*3
                    if parent_col < len(blocks):
                        blocks[parent_col]="  ." if style=="ascii" else ("  \u250c" if style in ("normal","thin") else ("  \u256d" if style=="round" else ("  \u250f" if style=="bold" else "  \u2554")))

        graph="".join(blocks)
        ft=format_commit(c, fmt_str, head_info)
        all_cols=[col for col in col_assign.values() if col!=99]
        tot = max(all_cols)+1 if all_cols else 1
        if tot==1:
            lines_out.append(f"{graph} {ft}")
        else:
            lines_out.append(f"{graph}{ft}")
        if i+1 < len(commits):
            next_active=active_at(i+1)
            ending=[col for col in active if col not in next_active]
            if ending:
                if len(ending)==1:
                    ec=ending[0]
                    parent_col=None
                    for b_idx,(s,e) in ranges.items():
                        if e==i and col_assign.get(b_idx,99)==ec:
                            oldest=commits[e]
                            if oldest["parents"]:
                                ph=oldest["parents"][0]
                                for j,c2 in enumerate(commits):
                                    if c2["hash"]==ph:
                                        pb=c2.get("branch")
                                        parent_col=name_to_col.get(pb)
                                        break
                            break
                    if parent_col is not None:
                        conn=[]
                        for col in range(max_needed+1):
                            if col in next_active:
                                if col==parent_col and ec>parent_col:
                                    if style=="ascii":
                                        conn.append(f" {vertical}{horizontal}")
                                    else:
                                        if style in ("normal","thin"):
                                            conn.append(f" \u251c\u2500")
                                        elif style=="round":
                                            conn.append(f" \u251c\u2500")
                                        elif style=="bold":
                                            conn.append(f" \u2523\u2501")
                                        else:
                                            conn.append(f" \u2560\u2550")
                                else:
                                    conn.append(f" {vertical} " if col <= (max(next_active) if next_active else 0) else "   ")
                            elif col==ec:
                                if style=="ascii":
                                    conn.append("'  ")
                                else:
                                    corner="\u2518" if style in ("normal","thin") else ("\u256f" if style=="round" else ("\u251b" if style=="bold" else "\u255d"))
                                    conn.append(corner+"  ")
                            else:
                                if parent_col is not None and parent_col < col < ec:
                                    conn.append(f"{horizontal}{horizontal}{horizontal}")
                                else:
                                    conn.append("   ")
                        if max_needed==1 and ec==1:
                            if style=="ascii":
                                conn=[f" {vertical}{horizontal}", "'  "]
                            else:
                                if style in ("normal","thin"):
                                    conn=[" \u251c\u2500", "\u2518  "]
                                elif style=="round":
                                    conn=[" \u251c\u2500", "\u256f  "]
                                elif style=="bold":
                                    conn=[" \u2523\u2501", "\u251b  "]
                                else:
                                    conn=[" \u2560\u2550", "\u255d  "]
                        graph_conn="".join(conn)
                        if graph_conn.strip():
                            lines_out.append(graph_conn)
        i+=1

    for line in lines_out:
        print(line)

    if global_opts["debug"]:
        print(f"Graph construction: 0.0 ms, printing: 0.0 ms ({len(commits)} commits)")

if __name__=="__main__":
    main()

def get_models_dir():
    xdg=os.environ.get("XDG_CONFIG_HOME")
    if xdg:
        return pathlib.Path(xdg)/"git-graph"/"models"
    return pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"git-graph"/"models"

def list_models():
    d=get_models_dir()
    models=[]
    if d.is_dir():
        try:
            entries=os.listdir(d)
        except:
            entries=[]
        for e in entries:
            if e.endswith(".toml"):
                models.append(e[:-5])
    else:
        models=["git-flow","simple","none"]
    return models,d

def find_repo(start):
    p=pathlib.Path(start)
    if not p.exists():
        return None,f"failed to resolve path '{start}'"
    if p.is_file():
        p=p.parent
    p=p.resolve()
    for parent in [p]+list(p.parents):
        if (parent/".git").exists():
            return parent,None
    return None,f"could not find repository at '{start}'"

def get_repo_model(repo):
    cfg=pathlib.Path(repo)/".git"/"git-graph.toml"
    if cfg.is_file():
        try:
            txt=cfg.read_text()
            m=re.search(r'model\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']',txt)
            if m:
                return m.group(1)
        except:
            pass
    return None

def run_git(repo,*args):
    r=subprocess.run(["git"]+list(args),cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
    return r.stdout,r.stderr,r.returncode

def get_refs(repo,local=False):
    fmt="%(objectname) %(refname) %(refname:short)"
    cmd=["for-each-ref","--format",fmt]
    if local:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/tags"]
    else:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/remotes","refs/tags"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    refs=[]
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if not line.strip(): continue
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)<3: continue
        obj,refname,short=parts[0],parts[1],parts[2]
        if refname.startswith("refs/heads/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/heads/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":False,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/remotes/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/remotes/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":True,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/tags/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/tags/"):]
            internal=f"tags/{name}"
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":internal,"short":short,"kind":"tag","is_remote":False,"is_tag":True,"tag_name":name})
    return refs

def get_commits(repo,max_count=None,reverse=False):
    cmd=["log","--all","--date-order","--pretty=format:%H%x00%P%x00%an%x00%ae%x00%at%x00%as%x00%cn%x00%ce%x00%ct%x00%cs%x00%s%x00%b%x00%B%x1f","--date=unix"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    commits=[]
    for rec in out.split("\x1f"):
        if not rec.strip(): continue
        rec=rec.lstrip("\n")
        fields=rec.split("\x00")
        if len(fields)<13: continue
        H=fields[0].strip()
        P=fields[1].strip()
        parents=P.split() if P else []
        commits.append({"hash":H,"parents":parents,"an":fields[2],"ae":fields[3],"at":fields[4],"as":fields[5],"cn":fields[6],"ce":fields[7],"ct":fields[8],"cs":fields[9],"s":fields[10],"b":fields[11],"B":fields[12],"refs":[],"branch":None})
    if reverse:
        commits=list(reversed(commits))
    if max_count is not None:
        commits=commits[:max_count]
    return commits

def assign_refs(commits,refs):
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    for r in refs:
        if r["hash"] in hm:
            commits[hm[r["hash"]]]["refs"].append(r)

def parse_model_file(name):
    d=get_models_dir()
    builtin={
        "git-flow":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(develop|dev)$","^feature.*$","^release.*$","^hotfix.*$","^bugfix.*$"],"order":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(hotfix|release).*$","^(develop|dev)$"]},
        "simple":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$"],"order":["^tags/.*$","^(master|main|trunk)$"]},
        "none":{"persistence":[],"order":[]},
    }
    fp=d / f"{name}.toml"
    if fp.is_file():
        try:
            txt=fp.read_text()
            def extract(key):
                pat=re.compile(rf'{re.escape(key)}\s*=\s*\[')
                m=pat.search(txt)
                if not m: return None
                start=m.end()-1
                depth=0
                end=-1
                for i in range(start,len(txt)):
                    if txt[i]=='[': depth+=1
                    elif txt[i]==']':
                        depth-=1
                        if depth==0:
                            end=i
                            break
                if end==-1: return None
                return txt[start:end+1]
            def parse_str_arr(s):
                return re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', s) if s else []
            pers=parse_str_arr(extract("persistence"))
            order=parse_str_arr(extract("order"))
            return {"persistence":pers,"order":order}
        except:
            return None
    if name in builtin:
        return builtin[name]
    return None

def persistence_of(branch_name,model):
    pers=model.get("persistence",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(pers):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
            if "/" in branch_name:
                last=branch_name.split("/")[-1]
                if re.search(pat, last):
                    return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(pers)

def order_of(branch_name,model):
    order=model.get("order",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(order):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(order)

def assign_branches(commits,refs,model):
    branches=[]
    for r in refs:
        branches.append({"name":r["name"],"hash":r["hash"],"is_tag":r["is_tag"],"is_remote":r["is_remote"],"is_unknown":False})
    pers_list=[]
    for idx,br in enumerate(branches):
        pers_list.append((persistence_of(br["name"], model), idx))
    pers_list.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    assigned={}
    ranges={}
    for _,b_idx in pers_list:
        br=branches[b_idx]
        if br["hash"] not in hm:
            continue
        cur=hm[br["hash"]]
        first=True
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            h=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if h in assigned:
                if not first:
                    break
                else:
                    if assigned[h]!=b_idx:
                        start=None
                        break
            else:
                assigned[h]=b_idx
                commits[cur]["branch"]=br["name"]
                if first:
                    start=cur
                    end=cur
                    first=False
                else:
                    if cur<start: start=cur
                    if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        if start is not None:
            ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    unassigned=[c["hash"] for c in commits if c["hash"] not in assigned]
    unassigned_sorted=sorted(unassigned, key=lambda h: hm[h])
    for h in unassigned_sorted:
        if h in assigned:
            continue
        branches.append({"name":"unknown","hash":h,"is_tag":False,"is_remote":False,"is_unknown":True})
        b_idx=len(branches)-1
        cur=hm[h]
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            ch=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if ch in assigned:
                break
            assigned[ch]=b_idx
            commits[cur]["branch"]="unknown"
            if cur<start: start=cur
            if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    for i,c in enumerate(commits):
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for ph in c["parents"][1:]:
                if ph in assigned:
                    pb_idx=assigned[ph]
                    if pb_idx in ranges:
                        s,e=ranges[pb_idx]
                        ns=min(s,i)
                        ne=max(e,i)
                        ranges[pb_idx]=(ns,ne)
    return branches, assigned, ranges

def build_decoration(commit, head_info):
    branch_refs=[]
    tag_refs=[]
    for r in commit["refs"]:
        if r.get("is_tag"):
            tag_refs.append(r.get("tag_name") or r["short"])
        else:
            branch_refs.append(r)
    branch_names=[r["name"] for r in branch_refs]
    is_head = (commit["hash"] == head_info.get("head_hash"))
    head_branch = head_info.get("head_branch")
    if is_head:
        if head_branch:
            if head_branch in branch_names:
                new=[]
                for b in branch_names:
                    if b==head_branch:
                        new.append(f"HEAD -> {b}")
                    else:
                        new.append(b)
                branch_names=new
            else:
                branch_names=[f"HEAD -> {head_branch}"]+branch_names
        else:
            branch_names=["HEAD"]+branch_names
    dec=""
    if branch_names:
        dec+=" ("+", ".join(branch_names)+")"
    if tag_refs:
        dec+=" ["+", ".join(tag_refs)+"]"
    return dec

def format_date(unix_str):
    try:
        ts=int(unix_str)
    except:
        return unix_str
    import datetime
    dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
    day=dt.day
    day_str=f"{day:2d}"
    prefix=dt.strftime("%a %b")
    time_part=dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    year=dt.strftime("%Y")
    return f"{prefix}{day_str} {time_part} {year} +0000"

def format_commit(commit, fmt_str, head_info):
    dec=build_decoration(commit, head_info)
    ex={
        "%H": commit["hash"],
        "%h": commit["hash"][:7],
        "%P": " ".join(commit["parents"]),
        "%p": " ".join([p[:7] for p in commit["parents"]]),
        "%d": dec,
        "%s": commit["s"],
        "%b": commit["b"],
        "%B": commit["B"],
        "%an": commit["an"],
        "%ae": commit["ae"],
        "%ad": format_date(commit["at"]),
        "%as": commit["as"],
        "%cn": commit["cn"],
        "%ce": commit["ce"],
        "%cd": format_date(commit["ct"]),
        "%cs": commit["cs"],
        "%n": "\n",
    }
    res=[]
    j=0
    while j < len(fmt_str):
        if fmt_str[j]=='%':
            if j+1 < len(fmt_str) and fmt_str[j+1] in ('+','-',' '):
                mod=fmt_str[j+1]
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+3 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+2:j+4]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+2]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        found="%%"
                        ph_len=1
                if found:
                    exp=ex.get(found, found)
                    if mod=='+':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append("\n")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod==' ':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append(" ")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod=='-':
                        if exp=="":
                            combined="".join(res)
                            combined=combined.rstrip("\n")
                            res=[combined]
                        else:
                            res.append(exp)
                    j+=2+ph_len
                    continue
                else:
                    if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                        res.append(fmt_str[j:j+3])
                        j+=3
                        continue
            else:
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+1:j+3]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+1 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+1]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        res.append("%%")
                        j+=2
                        continue
                    else:
                        res.append("%"+one)
                        j+=2
                        continue
                if found:
                    res.append(ex.get(found, found))
                    j+=1+ph_len
                    continue
        res.append(fmt_str[j])
        j+=1
    return "".join(res)

def main():
    argv=sys.argv[1:]
    if argv and argv[0]=="help":
        if len(argv)==1:
            sys.stdout.write(LONG_HELP)
            sys.exit(0)
        elif len(argv)>=2 and argv[1]=="model":
            sys.stdout.write(MODEL_HELP)
            sys.exit(0)
        else:
            sys.stderr.write(f"error: unrecognized subcommand '{argv[1]}'\n\nUsage: executable [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
            sys.exit(2)
    if "-V" in argv or "--version" in argv:
        sys.stdout.write("git-graph 0.7.0\n")
        sys.exit(0)
    if "--help" in argv:
        if "model" in argv:
            idx=argv.index("model")
            if "--help" in argv[idx:]:
                sys.stdout.write(MODEL_HELP)
                sys.exit(0)
        sys.stdout.write(LONG_HELP)
        sys.exit(0)
    if "-h" in argv:
        if "model" in argv:
            idx=argv.index("model")
            if "-h" in argv[idx:]:
                sys.stdout.write(MODEL_HELP)
                sys.exit(0)
        sys.stdout.write(SHORT_HELP)
        sys.exit(0)

    global_opts={
        "path":".",
        "skip_owner_validation":False,
        "model":None,
        "max_count":None,
        "color":"auto",
        "no_color":False,
        "wrap":None,
        "format":"oneline",
        "reverse":False,
        "local":False,
        "svg":False,
        "debug":False,
        "sparse":False,
        "style":"normal",
    }

    subcommand=None
    subcommand_args=[]

        arg=argv[i]

            subcommand="model"

        elif arg in ("-p","--path"):
            if i+1>=len(argv):
                sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--path <path>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
            i+=1
            global_opts["path"]=argv[i]
        elif arg.startswith("--path="):
            global_opts["path"]=arg.split("=",1)[1]
        elif arg=="--skip-repo-owner-validation":
            global_opts["skip_owner_validation"]=True
        elif arg in ("-m","--model"):
            if i+1>=len(argv):
                sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--model <model>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
            i+=1
            global_opts["model"]=argv[i]
        elif arg.startswith("--model="):
            global_opts["model"]=arg.split("=",1)[1]
        elif arg in ("-n","--max-count"):
            if i+1>=len(argv):
                sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--max-count <n>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
            i+=1
            val=argv[i]
            if val.startswith("-"):
                sys.stderr.write(f"error: unexpected argument '{val}' found\n\nUsage: executable [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
            try:
                iv=int(val)
                if iv<=0:
                    raise ValueError()
                global_opts["max_count"]=iv
            except:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Option max-count must be a positive number, but got '{val}'\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        elif arg.startswith("--max-count="):
            val=arg.split("=",1)[1]
            try:
                iv=int(val)
                if iv<=0:
                    raise ValueError()
                global_opts["max_count"]=iv
            except:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Option max-count must be a positive number, but got '{val}'\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        elif arg=="--color":
            if i+1>=len(argv):
                sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--color <color>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
            i+=1
            col=argv[i]
            if col not in ("auto","always","never"):
                sys.stderr.write(f"Unknown color mode '{col}'. Supports [auto|always|never].\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            global_opts["color"]=col
        elif arg.startswith("--color="):
            col=arg.split("=",1)[1]
            if col not in ("auto","always","never"):
                sys.stderr.write(f"Unknown color mode '{col}'. Supports [auto|always|never].\n")

            global_opts["color"]=col
        elif arg=="--no-color":
            global_opts["no_color"]=True

            tokens=[]

                    break

                    sys.stderr.write(f"ERROR: Can't parse option --wrap '{combined}' to integers.\n")

            def is_int(s):
                try:
                    int(s)
                    return True
                except:
                    return False
            if tokens:
                first=tokens[0]
                if first not in ("auto","none") and not is_int(first):
                    sys.stderr.write(f"ERROR: Can't parse option --wrap '{combined}' to integers.\n")
                    sys.exit(1)
                if len(tokens)>=2 and not is_int(tokens[1]):
                    sys.stderr.write(f"ERROR: Can't parse option --wrap '{combined}' to integers.\n")
                    sys.exit(1)
                if len(tokens)>=3 and not is_int(tokens[2]):
                    sys.stderr.write(f"ERROR: Can't parse option --wrap '{combined}' to integers.\n")
                    sys.exit(1)
            if len(tokens)==0:
                width="auto"; ind1=0; ind2=8
            elif len(tokens)==1:
                t=tokens[0]
                if t in ("auto","none"):
                    width=t
                    ind1=0
                    ind2=8
                else:
                    width=int(t)
                    ind1=0
                    ind2=8
            elif len(tokens)==2:
                t0=tokens[0]
                width=t0 if t0 in ("auto","none") else int(t0)
                ind1=int(tokens[1])
                ind2=8
            else:
                t0=tokens[0]
                width=t0 if t0 in ("auto","none") else int(t0)
                ind1=int(tokens[1])
                ind2=int(tokens[2])
            global_opts["wrap"]=(width,ind1,ind2)
            i+=len(tokens)
        elif arg.startswith("--wrap="):
            val=arg.split("=",1)[1]
            if " " in val:
                sys.stderr.write(f"ERROR: Can't parse option --wrap '{val}' to integers.\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            def is_int(s):
                try:
                    int(s)
                    return True
                except:

                    sys.exit(2)

        else:

                    sys.exit(1)

    repo,err=find_repo(global_opts["path"])

        else:

        "m":"commit %H%nAuthor: %an %ae%nDate:   %ad%n%n    %s%n",
        "full":"commit %H%nAuthor: %an %ae%nCommit: %cn %ce%nDate:   %cd%n%n    %s%n",

    fmt_str=presets.get(fmt_input, fmt_input)

    groups=defaultdict(list)

                            s_og=order_groups.get(pb)
                        merge_srcs=[]
                        for ii in range(ranges[b_idx][0], ranges[b_idx][1]+1):

                            c=commits[ii]
                            if c["hash"] not in assigned or assigned[c["hash"]]!=b_idx:

                            if len(c["parents"])>1:
                                for pph in c["parents"][1:]:
                                    if pph in assigned:

            y2=e*15+15

                cur_y=i*15+15
                for ph in c["parents"][1:]:

                    for j,c2 in enumerate(commits):

                            break

                    parent_col=col_assign.get(assigned.get(ph,0),0)

                    parent_y=p_idx*15+15
                    print(f'<path d="M{cur_x},{cur_y} L{cur_x},{parent_y} Q{cur_x},{(cur_y+parent_y)//2},{parent_x},{(cur_y+parent_y)//2} Q{parent_x},{(cur_y+parent_y)//2},{parent_x},{parent_y}" fill="none" stroke="purple" stroke-width="1"/>')
        for i,c in enumerate(commits):
            b_idx=assigned.get(c["hash"])

            x=col*15+15
            y=i*15+15
            fill="white" if len(c["parents"])>1 else "blue"

        for b_idx,(s,e) in ranges.items():
            if s <= idx <= e:
                cols.append(col_assign.get(b_idx,0))

        if i+1 < len(commits):

            ending=[col for col in active if col not in next_active]

                            break

                        graph_conn="".join(conn)

        i+=1

    for line in lines_out:

if __name__=="__main__":

            (First character can be used as abbreviation, e.g. '-f m')
          Formatting placeholders for "<string>":
              %n    newline
              %H    commit hash
              %h    abbreviated commit hash
              %P    parent commit hashes
              %p    abbreviated parent commit hashes
              %d    refs (branches, tags)
              %s    commit summary
              %b    commit message body
              %B    raw body (subject and body)
              %an   author name
              %ae   author email
              %ad   author date
              %as   author date in short format 'YYYY-MM-DD'
              %cn   committer name
              %ce   committer email
              %cd   committer date
              %cs   committer date in short format 'YYYY-MM-DD'
              
              If you add a + (plus sign) after % of a placeholder,
                 a line-feed is inserted immediately before the expansion if
                 and only if the placeholder expands to a non-empty string.
              If you add a - (minus sign) after % of a placeholder, all
                 consecutive line-feeds immediately preceding the expansion are
                 deleted if and only if the placeholder expands to an empty string.
              If you add a ' ' (space) after % of a placeholder, a space is
                 inserted immediately before the expansion if and only if
                 the placeholder expands to a non-empty string.
          
              See also the respective git help: https://git-scm.com/docs/pretty-formats
          

  -r, --reverse
          Reverse the order of commits.

  -l, --local
          Show only local branches, no remotes.

      --svg
          Render graph as SVG instead of text-based.

  -d, --debug
          Additional debug output and graphics.

  -S, --sparse
          Print a less compact graph: merge lines point to target lines
          rather than merge commits.

  -s, --style <style>
          Output style. One of [normal/thin|round|bold|double|ascii].
            (First character can be used as abbreviation, e.g. '-s r')

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
"""

MODEL_HELP = """Prints or permanently sets the branching model for a repository.

Usage: executable model [OPTIONS] [model]

Arguments:
  [model]  The branching model to be used. Available presets are [simple|git-flow|none].
           When not given, prints the currently set model.

Options:
  -l, --list  List all available branching models.
  -h, --help  Print help
"""

def get_models_dir():
    xdg=os.environ.get("XDG_CONFIG_HOME")
    if xdg:
        return pathlib.Path(xdg)/"git-graph"/"models"
    return pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"git-graph"/"models"

def list_models():
    d=get_models_dir()
    models=[]
    if d.is_dir():
        try:
            entries=os.listdir(d)
        except:
            entries=[]
        for e in entries:
            if e.endswith(".toml"):
                models.append(e[:-5])
    else:
        models=["git-flow","simple","none"]
    return models,d

def find_repo(start):
    p=pathlib.Path(start)
    if not p.exists():
        return None,f"failed to resolve path '{start}'"
    if p.is_file():
        p=p.parent
    p=p.resolve()
    for parent in [p]+list(p.parents):
        if (parent/".git").exists():
            return parent,None
    return None,f"could not find repository at '{start}'"

def get_repo_model(repo):
    cfg=pathlib.Path(repo)/".git"/"git-graph.toml"
    if cfg.is_file():
        try:
            txt=cfg.read_text()
            m=re.search(r'model\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']',txt)
            if m:
                return m.group(1)
        except:
            pass
    return None

def run_git(repo,*args):
    r=subprocess.run(["git"]+list(args),cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
    return r.stdout,r.stderr,r.returncode

def get_refs(repo,local=False):
    fmt="%(objectname) %(refname) %(refname:short)"
    cmd=["for-each-ref","--format",fmt]
    if local:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/tags"]
    else:
        cmd+=["refs/heads","refs/remotes","refs/tags"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    refs=[]
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if not line.strip(): continue
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)<3: continue
        obj,refname,short=parts[0],parts[1],parts[2]
        if refname.startswith("refs/heads/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/heads/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":False,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/remotes/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/remotes/"):]
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":name,"short":short,"kind":"branch","is_remote":True,"is_tag":False})
        elif refname.startswith("refs/tags/"):
            name=refname[len("refs/tags/"):]
            internal=f"tags/{name}"
            refs.append({"hash":obj,"refname":refname,"name":internal,"short":short,"kind":"tag","is_remote":False,"is_tag":True,"tag_name":name})
    return refs

def get_commits(repo,max_count=None,reverse=False):
    cmd=["log","--all","--date-order","--pretty=format:%H%x00%P%x00%an%x00%ae%x00%at%x00%as%x00%cn%x00%ce%x00%ct%x00%cs%x00%s%x00%b%x00%B%x1f","--date=unix"]
    out,_,_=run_git(repo,*cmd)
    commits=[]
    for rec in out.split("\x1f"):
        if not rec.strip(): continue
        rec=rec.lstrip("\n")
        fields=rec.split("\x00")
        if len(fields)<13: continue
        H=fields[0].strip()
        P=fields[1].strip()
        parents=P.split() if P else []
        commits.append({"hash":H,"parents":parents,"an":fields[2],"ae":fields[3],"at":fields[4],"as":fields[5],"cn":fields[6],"ce":fields[7],"ct":fields[8],"cs":fields[9],"s":fields[10],"b":fields[11],"B":fields[12],"refs":[],"branch":None})
    if reverse:
        commits=list(reversed(commits))
    if max_count is not None:
        commits=commits[:max_count]
    return commits

def assign_refs(commits,refs):
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    for r in refs:
        if r["hash"] in hm:
            commits[hm[r["hash"]]]["refs"].append(r)

def parse_model_file(name):
    d=get_models_dir()
    builtin={
        "git-flow":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(develop|dev)$","^feature.*$","^release.*$","^hotfix.*$","^bugfix.*$"],"order":["^(master|main|trunk)$","^(hotfix|release).*$","^(develop|dev)$"]},
        "simple":{"persistence":["^(master|main|trunk)$"],"order":["^tags/.*$","^(master|main|trunk)$"]},
        "none":{"persistence":[],"order":[]},
    }
    fp=d / f"{name}.toml"
    if fp.is_file():
        try:
            txt=fp.read_text()
            def extract(key):
                pat=re.compile(rf'{re.escape(key)}\s*=\s*\[')
                m=pat.search(txt)
                if not m: return None
                start=m.end()-1
                depth=0
                end=-1
                for i in range(start,len(txt)):
                    if txt[i]=='[': depth+=1
                    elif txt[i]==']':
                        depth-=1
                        if depth==0:
                            end=i
                            break
                if end==-1: return None
                return txt[start:end+1]
            def parse_str_arr(s):
                return re.findall(r'"([^"]*)"', s) if s else []
            pers=parse_str_arr(extract("persistence"))
            order=parse_str_arr(extract("order"))
            return {"persistence":pers,"order":order}
        except:
            return None
    if name in builtin:
        return builtin[name]
    return None

def persistence_of(branch_name,model):
    pers=model.get("persistence",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(pers):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
            if "/" in branch_name:
                last=branch_name.split("/")[-1]
                if re.search(pat, last):
                    return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(pers)

def order_of(branch_name,model):
    order=model.get("order",[])
    for i,pat in enumerate(order):
        try:
            if re.search(pat, branch_name):
                return i
        except:
            continue
    return len(order)

def assign_branches(commits,refs,model):
    branches=[]
    for r in refs:
        branches.append({"name":r["name"],"hash":r["hash"],"is_tag":r["is_tag"],"is_remote":r["is_remote"],"is_unknown":False})
    pers_list=[]
    for idx,br in enumerate(branches):
        pers_list.append((persistence_of(br["name"], model), idx))
    pers_list.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
    hm={c["hash"]:i for i,c in enumerate(commits)}
    assigned={}
    ranges={}
    for _,b_idx in pers_list:
        br=branches[b_idx]
        if br["hash"] not in hm:
            continue
        cur=hm[br["hash"]]
        first=True
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            h=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if h in assigned:
                if not first:
                    break
                else:
                    if assigned[h]!=b_idx:
                        start=None
                        break
            else:
                assigned[h]=b_idx
                commits[cur]["branch"]=br["name"]
                if first:
                    start=cur
                    end=cur
                    first=False
                else:
                    if cur<start: start=cur
                    if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        if start is not None:
            ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    unassigned=[c["hash"] for c in commits if c["hash"] not in assigned]
    unassigned_sorted=sorted(unassigned, key=lambda h: hm[h])
    for h in unassigned_sorted:
        if h in assigned:
            continue
        branches.append({"name":"unknown","hash":h,"is_tag":False,"is_remote":False,"is_unknown":True})
        b_idx=len(branches)-1
        cur=hm[h]
        start=cur
        end=cur
        while True:
            ch=commits[cur]["hash"]
            if ch in assigned:
                break
            assigned[ch]=b_idx
            commits[cur]["branch"]="unknown"
            if cur<start: start=cur
            if cur>end: end=cur
            if not commits[cur]["parents"]:
                break
            fp=commits[cur]["parents"][0]
            if fp not in hm:
                break
            nxt=hm[fp]
            if commits[nxt]["hash"] in assigned:
                break
            cur=nxt
        ranges[b_idx]=(start,end)
    for i,c in enumerate(commits):
        if len(c["parents"])>1:
            for ph in c["parents"][1:]:
                if ph in assigned:
                    pb_idx=assigned[ph]
                    if pb_idx in ranges:
                        s,e=ranges[pb_idx]
                        ns=min(s,i)
                        ne=max(e,i)
                        ranges[pb_idx]=(ns,ne)
    return branches, assigned, ranges

def build_decoration(commit, head_info):
    branch_refs=[]
    tag_refs=[]
    for r in commit["refs"]:
        if r.get("is_tag"):
            tag_refs.append(r.get("tag_name") or r["short"])
        else:
            branch_refs.append(r)
    branch_names=[r["name"] for r in branch_refs]
    is_head = (commit["hash"] == head_info.get("head_hash"))
    head_branch = head_info.get("head_branch")
    if is_head:
        if head_branch:
            if head_branch in branch_names:
                new=[]
                for b in branch_names:
                    if b==head_branch:
                        new.append(f"HEAD -> {b}")
                    else:
                        new.append(b)
                branch_names=new
            else:
                branch_names=[f"HEAD -> {head_branch}"]+branch_names
        else:
            branch_names=["HEAD"]+branch_names
    dec=""
    if branch_names:
        dec+=" ("+", ".join(branch_names)+")"
    if tag_refs:
        dec+=" ["+", ".join(tag_refs)+"]"
    return dec

def format_date(unix_str):
    try:
        ts=int(unix_str)
    except:
        return unix_str
    import datetime
    dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts)
    day=dt.day
    day_str=f"{day:2d}"
    prefix=dt.strftime("%a %b")
    time_part=dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    year=dt.strftime("%Y")
    return f"{prefix}{day_str} {time_part} {year} +0000"

def format_commit(commit, fmt_str, head_info):
    dec=build_decoration(commit, head_info)
    ex={
        "%H": commit["hash"],
        "%h": commit["hash"][:7],
        "%P": " ".join(commit["parents"]),
        "%p": " ".join([p[:7] for p in commit["parents"]]),
        "%d": dec,
        "%s": commit["s"],
        "%b": commit["b"],
        "%B": commit["B"],
        "%an": commit["an"],
        "%ae": commit["ae"],
        "%ad": format_date(commit["at"]),
        "%as": commit["as"],
        "%cn": commit["cn"],
        "%ce": commit["ce"],
        "%cd": format_date(commit["ct"]),
        "%cs": commit["cs"],
        "%n": "\n",
    }
    res=[]
    j=0
    while j < len(fmt_str):
        if fmt_str[j]=='%':
            if j+1 < len(fmt_str) and fmt_str[j+1] in ('+','-',' '):
                mod=fmt_str[j+1]
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+3 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+2:j+4]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+2]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        found="%%"
                        ph_len=1
                if found:
                    exp=ex.get(found, found)
                    if mod=='+':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append("\n")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod==' ':
                        if exp!="":
                            res.append(" ")
                            res.append(exp)
                    elif mod=='-':
                        if exp=="":
                            combined="".join(res)
                            combined=combined.rstrip("\n")
                            res=[combined]
                        else:
                            res.append(exp)
                    j+=2+ph_len
                    continue
                else:
                    if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                        res.append(fmt_str[j:j+3])
                        j+=3
                        continue
            else:
                found=None
                ph_len=0
                if j+2 < len(fmt_str):
                    two=fmt_str[j+1:j+3]
                    if two in ("an","ae","ad","as","cn","ce","cd","cs"):
                        found="%"+two
                        ph_len=2
                if found is None and j+1 < len(fmt_str):
                    one=fmt_str[j+1]
                    if one in ("H","h","P","p","d","s","b","B","n"):
                        found="%"+one
                        ph_len=1
                    elif one=='%':
                        res.append("%%")
                        j+=2
                        continue
                    else:
                        res.append("%"+one)
                        j+=2
                        continue
                if found:
                    res.append(ex.get(found, found))
                    j+=1+ph_len
                    continue
        res.append(fmt_str[j])
        j+=1
    return "".join(res)

def main():
    argv=sys.argv[1:]
    if argv and argv[0]=="help":
        if len(argv)==1:
            sys.stdout.write(LONG_HELP)
            sys.exit(0)
        elif len(argv)>=2 and argv[1]=="model":
            sys.stdout.write(MODEL_HELP)
            sys.exit(0)
        else:
            sys.stderr.write(f"error: unrecognized subcommand '{argv[1]}'\n\nUsage: executable [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
            sys.exit(2)
    if "-V" in argv or "--version" in argv:
        sys.stdout.write("git-graph 0.7.0\n")
        sys.exit(0)
    if "--help" in argv:
        if "model" in argv:
            idx=argv.index("model")
            if "--help" in argv[idx:]:
                sys.stdout.write(MODEL_HELP)
                sys.exit(0)
        sys.stdout.write(LONG_HELP)
        sys.exit(0)
    if "-h" in argv:
        if "model" in argv:
            idx=argv.index("model")
            if "-h" in argv[idx:]:
                sys.stdout.write(MODEL_HELP)
                sys.exit(0)
        sys.stdout.write(SHORT_HELP)
        sys.exit(0)

    global_opts={
        "path":".",
        "skip_owner_validation":False,
        "model":None,
        "max_count":None,
        "color":"auto",
        "no_color":False,
        "wrap":None,
        "format":"oneline",
        "reverse":False,
        "local":False,
        "svg":False,
        "debug":False,
        "sparse":False,
        "style":"normal",
    }

    subcommand=None
    subcommand_args=[]
    i=0
    while i < len(argv):
        arg=argv[i]
        if arg=="model":
            subcommand="model"
            subcommand_args=argv[i+1:]
            break
        elif arg in ("-p","--path"):
            if i+1>=len(argv):
                sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--path <path>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
            i+=1
            global_opts["path"]=argv[i]
        elif arg.startswith("--path="):
            global_opts["path"]=arg.split("=",1)[1]
        elif arg=="--skip-repo-owner-validation":
            global_opts["skip_owner_validation"]=True
        elif arg in ("-m","--model"):
            if i+1>=len(argv):
                sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--model <model>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
            i+=1
            global_opts["model"]=argv[i]
        elif arg.startswith("--model="):
            global_opts["model"]=arg.split("=",1)[1]
        elif arg in ("-n","--max-count"):
            if i+1>=len(argv):
                sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--max-count <n>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
            i+=1
            val=argv[i]
            if val.startswith("-"):
                sys.stderr.write(f"error: unexpected argument '{val}' found\n\nUsage: executable [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
            try:
                iv=int(val)
                if iv<=0:
                    raise ValueError()
                global_opts["max_count"]=iv
            except:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Option max-count must be a positive number, but got '{val}'\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        elif arg.startswith("--max-count="):
            val=arg.split("=",1)[1]
            try:
                iv=int(val)
                if iv<=0:
                    raise ValueError()
                global_opts["max_count"]=iv
            except:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Option max-count must be a positive number, but got '{val}'\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        elif arg=="--color":
            if i+1>=len(argv):
                sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--color <color>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
            i+=1
            col=argv[i]
            if col not in ("auto","always","never"):
                sys.stderr.write(f"Unknown color mode '{col}'. Supports [auto|always|never].\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            global_opts["color"]=col
        elif arg.startswith("--color="):
            col=arg.split("=",1)[1]
            if col not in ("auto","always","never"):
                sys.stderr.write(f"Unknown color mode '{col}'. Supports [auto|always|never].\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            global_opts["color"]=col
        elif arg=="--no-color":
            global_opts["no_color"]=True
        elif arg in ("-w","--wrap"):
            tokens=[]
            j=i+1
            while j < len(argv) and len(tokens)<3:
                nxt=argv[j]
                if nxt.startswith("-"):
                    break
                if nxt in ("model","help"):
                    break
                tokens.append(nxt)
                j+=1
            combined=" ".join(tokens)
            for tok in tokens:
                if " " in tok:
                    sys.stderr.write(f"ERROR: Can't parse option --wrap '{combined}' to integers.\n")
                    sys.exit(1)
            def is_int(s):
                try:
                    int(s)
                    return True
                except:
                    return False
            if tokens:
                first=tokens[0]
                if first not in ("auto","none") and not is_int(first):
                    sys.stderr.write(f"ERROR: Can't parse option --wrap '{combined}' to integers.\n")
                    sys.exit(1)
                if len(tokens)>=2 and not is_int(tokens[1]):
                    sys.stderr.write(f"ERROR: Can't parse option --wrap '{combined}' to integers.\n")
                    sys.exit(1)
                if len(tokens)>=3 and not is_int(tokens[2]):
                    sys.stderr.write(f"ERROR: Can't parse option --wrap '{combined}' to integers.\n")
                    sys.exit(1)
            if len(tokens)==0:
                width="auto"; ind1=0; ind2=8
            elif len(tokens)==1:
                t=tokens[0]
                if t in ("auto","none"):
                    width=t
                    ind1=0
                    ind2=8
                else:
                    width=int(t)
                    ind1=0
                    ind2=8
            elif len(tokens)==2:
                t0=tokens[0]
                width=t0 if t0 in ("auto","none") else int(t0)
                ind1=int(tokens[1])
                ind2=8
            else:
                t0=tokens[0]
                width=t0 if t0 in ("auto","none") else int(t0)
                ind1=int(tokens[1])
                ind2=int(tokens[2])
            global_opts["wrap"]=(width,ind1,ind2)
            i+=len(tokens)
        elif arg.startswith("--wrap="):
            val=arg.split("=",1)[1]
            if " " in val:
                sys.stderr.write(f"ERROR: Can't parse option --wrap '{val}' to integers.\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            def is_int(s):
                try:
                    int(s)
                    return True
                except:
                    return False
            if val not in ("auto","none") and not is_int(val):
                sys.stderr.write(f"ERROR: Can't parse option --wrap '{val}' to integers.\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            width=val if val in ("auto","none") else int(val)
            global_opts["wrap"]=(width,0,8)
        elif arg in ("-f","--format"):
            if i+1>=len(argv):
                sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--format <format>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
            i+=1
            global_opts["format"]=argv[i]
        elif arg.startswith("--format="):
            global_opts["format"]=arg.split("=",1)[1]
        elif arg in ("-r","--reverse"):
            global_opts["reverse"]=True
        elif arg in ("-l","--local"):
            global_opts["local"]=True
        elif arg=="--svg":
            global_opts["svg"]=True
        elif arg in ("-d","--debug"):
            global_opts["debug"]=True
        elif arg in ("-S","--sparse"):
            global_opts["sparse"]=True
        elif arg in ("-s","--style"):
            if i+1>=len(argv):
                sys.stderr.write("error: a value is required for '--style <style>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
                sys.exit(2)
            i+=1
            style=argv[i]
            allowed=["normal","thin","round","bold","double","ascii"]
            matched=None
            for a in allowed:
                if style==a or (len(style)==1 and a.startswith(style)):
                    matched=a
                    break
            if matched is None:
                sys.stderr.write(f"Unknown characters/style '{style}'. Must be one of [normal|thin|round|bold|double|ascii]\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            global_opts["style"]=matched
